store_data.about_the_game:
OneTry is a third-person survival horror shooter.

You wake up inside a house with no memory of how you got there.

Outside, the world you once knew has been devoured by an outbreak that has turned humanity into the undead.

You must fight for your life while struggling to piece together the fragments of your memory.

Move cautiously through dark environments and find clues to unveil the mystery of your arrival and the origin of the epidemic.

Use your flashlight to explore and find your way, but remember: light can attract the attention of the infected.

You will need to thoroughly explore every area to find ways to unlock sealed doors and gain access to new sectors of the map.

Every abandoned corridor and pitch-black room tells a story of terror.

Uncover the truth before the darkness consumes you entirely.

store_data.about_the_game:
Switch between siblings and battle yokais (japanese monster)!
In the Meiji era (1906), yokais have emerged from the basement of an exploded armory and are wreaking havoc all over the place.
Shizuka, who fights with swords and guns, and Takeru, who fights with spears and clubs, set out to save everyone!
This is a Souls-like action game with a 2D top-down perspective.

Switch between characters and weapons to defeat 35 unique yokais. Each monster has different weaknesses to weapons and different behavior. Shizuka can attack from close to long range with her guns and swords, while Takeru can attack from wide to medium range with his club and spear. Switch between Shizuka and Takeru, and their weapons, to suit the enemy and the situation.

Use the golden spirits obtained by defeating yokais to freely build up both Takeru and Shizuka separately.

No matter what buildup you choose, you can use all weapons and armor available in the game.

You can obtain items from treasure chests on the field, items dropped by enemies, and items purchased at stores.

You will clear the game once you have defeated all the yokai bosses.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mecha × Tactics

Azure Infinity is a turn-based tactical SRPG game set in a near‑future sci‑fi world with a military mecha theme.

As an SRT member of the secret mercenary organization Yggdrasill, you will command the huge humanoid weapon RAIV to carry out a range of missions and confront the crisis approaching this world.

Whether you choose to manually control every action yourself, entrust your carefully crafted tactics to A.Z.U.R., the intelligent cockpit system installed in RAIV, or dynamically command your teammates to switch between different battle plans according to the flow of combat, the success of each mission depends entirely on your skill and precise judgment.

Characters

Story

By the late 2020s, all-solid-state batteries entered mass production and widespread adoption, eliminating power limitations for manned robots. Robotic autonomous interactive vehicles (RAIVs) began extensive deployment in transportation, construction, and even military applications.

In the year 2037 AD, before nuclear fusion power achieved practical application, armed conflict erupted in low Earth orbit between the world’s two major blocs, the Pan-Asia Democratic Cooperative (PadCo) and the Atlantic Treaty Alliance (ATA). This directly caused the complete collapse of the global satellite system. Although major powers immediately halted large-scale combat, regional conflicts persisted. As the primary hostilities concluded within a week, posterity dubbed this period “Seven Days' Conflict.”

The destruction of infrastructure triggered widespread energy and food crises. To prevent humanity from spiraling into a self‑destructive cycle of war, Maxwell, an entrepreneur originally dedicated to deep‑space exploration, secretly invested massive funds to establish the multinational military organization Yggdrasil. Operating covertly across the globe, Yggdrasil sought to maintain a fragile balance in world affairs, preventing excessive escalation between opposing factions that could lead to irreversible consequences.

In 2038, Yggdrasil’s Skuld Squad is carrying out a mission to escort a key physicist. No one could have foreseen that, from this moment onward, the gears of humanity’s destiny would begin to turn…

A New‑Style SRPG Blending Tradition and Innovation

  • Azure Infinity evolves from classic SRPG roots while drawing inspiration from renowned titles.

  • The hex‑grid map significantly enhances strategic depth while liberating scenarios from rigid square-based constraints.

  • Unit action order is determined by a combination of unit performance, pilot abilities, chosen actions, and automated tactical modes, each factor capable of shifting the tide of battle.

  • Players may manually control each ally unit for precise battlefield command, focus on specific units while issuing tactical orders to boost overall efficiency; or delegate full control to pre-programmed automated tactics systems, experiencing the satisfaction of orchestrating victory from the command center.

  • The component‑based damage system tests the player’s judgment: disable an enemy’s hands to prevent weapon use, destroy the legs to limit mobility, damage the head to weaken targeting capabilities, or directly breach the heavily armored body to neutralize the unit entirely.

Deep Mecha Customization and Weapon Systems

  • RAIVs developed by different manufacturers possess unique characteristics. Players can freely swap components between models to forge the ultimate war machine.

  • Load capacity, energy consumption, radar capability, weapon mount interfaces...every specification interacts and restricts the others. Whether creating a specialized super‑weapon or a well‑balanced all‑rounder, designing the strongest RAIV is a challenge in itself.

  • Bipedal, wheeled, tracked...different mobility types adapt to varied terrains while impacting load capacity and endurance.

  • Melee, projectile, missiles, lasers...diverse weapon systems not only vary in damage characteristics and attack patterns but also demand consideration of ammunition or energy capacity during RAIV design.

A.Z.U.R.: An Automated Tactical System of Infinite Possibilities

  • Capable of executing any action based on countless real-time battlefield conditions, A.Z.U.R. theoretically replicates player tactics with precision. Crafting and designing A.Z.U.R. will serve as a rigorous test of command proficiency.

  • Units gain enhanced action speed while under A.Z.U.R. control, amplifying the effectiveness of the strategies players carefully craft.

  • Each unit supports multiple predefined A.Z.U.R. strategy sets and allows switching between them mid‑battle, ensuring smooth combat flow while demanding players' timely and precise decision-making.

  • The training mode allows players to verify their A.Z.U.R. strategies and even enabling simulated drills with different strategies to compare tactical prowess.

A Story Woven by Distinctive Characters

  • A classic heroic tale begins with a single encounter, unfolding into a grand and gripping adventure brought to life by a cast of vivid, memorable characters.

  • Set in a near‑future sci‑fi world that straddles reality and fiction, imminent crises, and the deeper truths hidden beneath turbulent events will gradually unfold as players progress through their adventure.

A Creation Infused with the creator's passion for design and development

  • In this era, crafting an SRPG by someone who loves SRPGs, for players who love SRPGs, carries special meaning.

  • All character concepts and designs are crafted personally by the creator.

  • Every mecha, weapon, environment model, and UI elements are designed and built from scratch.

  • All story scripts and dialogue are carefully written by the creator; all music is composed and arranged note-by-note, and all sound effects are crafted from basic audio sources.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pirate & Dark Mage is a game where you can live at your own pace and go on adventures in a calm, unhurried world.

Your choices naturally shape how the world unfolds—and how the story changes.

Create a world that’s yours alone, and enjoy it your own way.

◆ The World

Through your adventures and your connections with the residents, the world and its stories gradually open up.

Take it easy for a day, or dive into quests and crafting—it’s entirely up to you.

◆ Exploration

Gathering points are scattered across the fields.

Defeat monsters and collect materials for crafting and quests as you explore.

There’s no stamina system, so you’re free to roam as long as you like.

◆ Battles with Monsters

Combat is turn-based, menu-driven.

As you grow through crafting and quests, you can even avoid fights altogether.

◆ Life Elements

Tedious chores like constant watering have been boldly removed.

Instead, you’ll find light life-sim elements—fishing, tending your fields, and bonding with animals—

designed to fit naturally alongside your adventures.

◆ A Branching Story

The story changes with your choices and your relationships with the residents.

Create a world that belongs to you alone.

◆ Flexible UI Layout

You can freely adjust the size and position of the UI.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌊 Welcome to a Stress-Free Underwater World

My Fish Friend is a peaceful, kid-friendly aquarium experience designed for toddlers (ages 2–3) and anyone who enjoys watching fish swim. Enjoy your own digital aquarium with 98 unlockable different fish and aquatic creatures, each with unique personalities, behaviors, and preferences. 

There are no goals, no timers, and no failure states — just calm exploration, gentle interaction, and learning through play.

Perfect for first-time gamers, families, educators, and anyone seeking a relaxing experience.

🫧 Gentle, Interactive Bubbles

  • Move the coral to create floating bubbles that rise naturally through the water

  • Click bubbles to pop them with a soft, satisfying “pop” and gentle animation

  • Bubbles spawn automatically every few seconds as you move the coral

  • Fish sometimes chase bubbles, creating playful, unpredictable moments

  • Bubbles pop on their own if untouched, keeping the aquarium clean and calm

The result is a mesmerizing underwater atmosphere that encourages curiosity and play.

🍽️ Feed Your Fish & Discover Their Favorites

Drop food into the aquarium and watch how each fish reacts differently based on personality and preference.

Food Types:

🐟 Fish Flakes

  • Drift slowly downward

  • Some fish chase eagerly, others glide calmly

  • Great for observing different swim styles

🦐 Tiny Shrimp

  • Fall at a moderate speed

  • Fish react with varied levels of excitement

  • Encourages patience and observation

✨ Pellets

  • Fish spin excitedly before chasing them

  • A favorite for visual delight

Each fish has a favorite food — drop it and they’ll swim at maximum speed with extra enthusiasm!

Food that reaches the bottom naturally disappears, keeping the aquarium tidy.

🐠 Unique Fish Personalities & Natural Behaviors

Every fish feels alive thanks to a rich personality system:

  • Different swimming speeds and movement styles

  • Individual reaction distances to food and bubbles

  • Favorite foods that trigger extra-excited behavior

  • Natural spacing preferences when following objects

  • Occasional bubble-chasing for playful variety

  • Intelligent obstacle and ground avoidance

  • Smooth, lifelike turns and navigation

🎮 Simple, Flexible Controls

Designed for comfort and accessibility:

Mouse Controls

  • Click to drop food

  • Click bubbles to pop

Keyboard Controls (Optional)

  • Space/Click – Drop food

  • WASD / Arrow Keys – Move the magic coral

  • 1 / 2 / 3 – Select food types

  • Q / E – Cycle food

  • Tab / Shift+Tab – Switch fish

  • Esc or C – Toggle controls menu

🎨 Calm Visuals & Gentle Audio

  • Soft ambient water sounds for relaxation

  • Friendly sound effects for every interaction

  • Smooth fish movement

  • Flakes, pellets, shrimp and floating bubbles

  • Fish always stay visible on screen

  • Clean, uncluttered interface for young users

Custom Audio Controls

Parents can adjust sound easily:

  • Master Volume

  • Sound Effects Volume

  • Ambient Music Volume

Perfect for children with sound sensitivity.

🐟 Fish Collection & Focused Play

  • Cycle through your fish collection with ease

  • Activate one fish at a time with no overstimulation

  • Clear visual and audio feedback when switching fish

The system handles everything automatically — no setup or management required.

🎓 Learning Through Play

My Fish Friend encourages early learning without pressure:

  • Learn the names of 98 fish and aquatic creatures

  • Understand cause and effect through interaction

  • Observe animal behavior and preferences

  • Develop hand-eye coordination and motor skills through popping bubbles

  • Build patience, attention, and curiosity

🌈 Perfect For

  • 👶 Toddlers (Ages 2–3)

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Parents & caregivers

  • 🏫 Early childhood education

  • ♿ Children with special needs

  • 🐠 Fish & aquarium lovers

  • 😌 Anyone seeking relaxation

  • 👵 Seniors looking for gentle interaction

✨ Key Features

  • 98 unique fish and aquatic species

  • No timers, no losing, no pressure

  • Interactive bubbles and feeding

  • Fish personalities and favorite foods

  • Mouse and keyboard controls

  • Customizable audio settings

  • Smooth animations and calming visuals

  • Educational, safe, and accessible design

💙 What Makes My Fish Friend Special

  • Designed specifically for toddlers

  • Learning happens naturally through play

  • Truly stress-free — no failure states

  • Accessible for all ages and abilities

  • Relaxing yet playful aquarium experience

Thank you so much for your interest in *Deck Breakers*! We hope you can join Ganymede and your companions on this ship of despair, breaking down the walls and reclaiming a free future for humanity.

▶ A JRPG narrative experience about resistance, bonds, and survival

In 2125, the *Salvison*, humanity's last home, appears to be an ark of civilization, but secretly serves as a human experimentation site for the dictatorial organization "Purification Society." You will play as Ganymede, an ordinary person who survived the disaster and joins the resistance organization "Wallbreakers." Side-by-side with the mysterious scientist Dr. Entropy, under tight surveillance and the threat of mutant creatures, you will gradually uncover the dark truth behind the lie of "evolution." This is a plot-driven world full of suspense, human choices, and science fiction elements; every dialogue and decision can affect your fate and that of your companions.

▶ Auto Chess × Deep Strategy Team Building

· Assemble your 6-person squad: Recruit characters with unique attributes and skills, explore the 2.5D side-scrolling ship world, rescue companions, and gradually strengthen your team.

· Trigger bonds and awaken advanced power: Characters will develop emotional connections through the story and battles. When bonds reach a certain level, powerful advanced skills will be unlocked, qualitatively changing tactical dimensions.

· Customize your combat style with "combat chips": Collect various passive attribute chips and freely equip them before battle to influence the characters' behavior and effects in automatic battles, allowing the same team to unleash completely different and dazzling combos.

— We look forward to meeting you on the Salvation.

4330890.name: PIECES OF THE DEEP 〜海底遺産回収録〜

store_data.about_the_game:
Run through the depths.
Recover the relics of a lost civilization.

PIECES OF THE DEEP is a roguelite action game built around auto-running exploration, where split-second decisions determine survival.

You play as Nyarmar, a small creature who lost its home in a massive seabed quake.
Rescued by a team of surface-dwelling explorers, you repay their kindness by helping with dangerous deep-sea expeditions.

■ Procedurally Generated Dungeons × Instant Decisions

Each dungeon is procedurally generated.
Your character runs forward automatically—your role is to dodge hazards, defeat enemies, and choose branching paths while pushing toward the depths.

Simple controls, demanding judgment.
Every moment matters.

■ Recover Relics and Expand Your Base

At the end of each dungeon awaits a powerful boss.
Defeat it to obtain relics left behind by an ancient civilization—materials and incomplete blueprints scattered across the seabed.

Back at base, recovered relics are analyzed and used to restore advanced technology,
unlocking new capabilities for even deeper dives.

Explore. Recover. Grow stronger. Dive again.

■ A Story from the One Who Retrieves

You are not the one who deciphers the past.
You are the one who descends—again and again—to bring something back.

This is not the story of a hero who saves the world,
but a record of those who recover what was lost.

■ Streaming & Content Creation Policy

Gameplay videos, livestreams, and other related content are welcome.
Monetization is allowed for both individuals and organizations.

No prior permission is required.
Including a link to the Steam store page in your description is appreciated.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lisa: Silence in the Rain is a long-form, story driven RPG about ordinary life colliding with irreversible consequence.

You play as Lisa, a young woman finishing her final year of college in a city quietly fraying at the edges. What begins as a grounded, slice of life experience with part-time work, friendships and daily routine slowly unravels after a chance encounter pulls her into the orbit of a powerful criminal family. From that moment on, survival is no longer about escape, but about judgment.

This is a slow and methodical narrative shaped by imperfect people making impossible choices. Trust is rarely clean. Loyalty is often conditional. Intentions overlap, fracture, and contradict one another and betrayal is sometimes a matter of perspective, not something born of malice.

Motivations in Lisa: Silence in the Rain are rarely framed as “right” or “wrong.” Information is incomplete. Motives are obscured. Small decisions echo forward, sometimes revealing their true cost only hours or acts later. The story is deliberately paced, allowing characters, relationships, and consequences to settle before their full weight becomes clear.

Conversation matters. Silence matters.

Features

  • A female protagonist with a defined emotional arc shaped by endurance, loss, and moral resolve

  • Branching decisions influenced by partial information, conflicting interests, and human fallibility

  • A cinematic presentation blending 3D environments with animated and narrative driven sequences

  • Themes of control, trust, intimacy, sacrifice, and consequence

  • Optional adult content intended for mature audiences only

While the game contains explicit sexual content, Lisa: Silence in the Rain is not a power fantasy or a traditional dating sim. Intimacy and vulnerability are treated as narrative elements; sources of tension, connection, and risk.

This is a story that unfolds patiently. It does not rush to resolution, and it does not offer clean victories. It asks the player to live with their decisions and the people those decisions affect long after the rain has stopped.
store_data.detailed_description:
Lisa: Silence in the Rain is a long-form, story driven RPG about ordinary life colliding with irreversible consequence.

You play as Lisa, a young woman finishing her final year of college in a city quietly fraying at the edges. What begins as a grounded, slice of life experience with part-time work, friendships and daily routine slowly unravels after a chance encounter pulls her into the orbit of a powerful criminal family. From that moment on, survival is no longer about escape, but about judgment.

This is a slow and methodical narrative shaped by imperfect people making impossible choices. Trust is rarely clean. Loyalty is often conditional. Intentions overlap, fracture, and contradict one another and betrayal is sometimes a matter of perspective, not something born of malice.

Motivations in Lisa: Silence in the Rain are rarely framed as “right” or “wrong.” Information is incomplete. Motives are obscured. Small decisions echo forward, sometimes revealing their true cost only hours or acts later. The story is deliberately paced, allowing characters, relationships, and consequences to settle before their full weight becomes clear.

Conversation matters. Silence matters.

Features

  • A female protagonist with a defined emotional arc shaped by endurance, loss, and moral resolve

  • Branching decisions influenced by partial information, conflicting interests, and human fallibility

  • A cinematic presentation blending 3D environments with animated and narrative driven sequences

  • Themes of control, trust, intimacy, sacrifice, and consequence

  • Optional adult content intended for mature audiences only

While the game contains explicit sexual content, Lisa: Silence in the Rain is not a power fantasy or a traditional dating sim. Intimacy and vulnerability are treated as narrative elements; sources of tension, connection, and risk.

This is a story that unfolds patiently. It does not rush to resolution, and it does not offer clean victories. It asks the player to live with their decisions and the people those decisions affect long after the rain has stopped.
store_data.short_description: A slow-burn, character-driven RPG about an ordinary young woman drawn into a city’s criminal underworld where trust is fragile, choices carry lasting consequences, and doing the right thing rarely comes without cost.

store_data.about_the_game:
The resources for magic are being hoarded by the powerful, and all known deposits have long run dry. Play as an explorer who is searching for any remaining sources of magic crystals, and complete repeated runs in this rogue-lite spellbuilder to try and secure a new supply of magic for the common people.

BUILD YOUR OWN BULLET HELL

Magic is not something to take lightly, yet you will need enough fire-power to clear out all the hostile remnants from the old world. Strike a balance between building larger chain-reactions and leaving yourself enough space to avoid them all, as all magic has the potential to bite.

SHARED DREAMS

Everyday you will attempt to secure the supply in a new way, and everyday you will return to camp where other like-minded explorers have settled. See how other individuals approach creating magics, and help them overcome their own fears that prevent them from committing fully to chasing their dreams.

BURNING OUT THE WORLD

Uncover the mysteries of why magic crystals have become such a scarce resource, discover the truths of the depravity of an enemy that can not be beaten. Find your own answer for how to handle the fact that something is always in the way of your dreams.

A PREMORTEM STYLE FOR THOSE ALIVE

Art is made for the living, and PreMortem aims to create vivid, handcrafted pieces of fun adventure with underlying depth and emotion inspired by real life struggles.

基本信息

游戏名称：《星珀庄园的花语》

游戏类型：横版2D解谜游戏

故事介绍

很久以前，陨石席卷了这座城市。

无数陨石碎片散落各处，像天空遗落的星辰。

多年后，城市逐渐恢复生机。星珀庄园的女主人月瑶，她作为一位热爱植物的学者，在自家地下室意外发现了一个小小的陨石坑，坑中长满了发光的蓝色苔藓，如同地底的星河…………

出于植物学家的好奇心，月瑶将这些奇异的苔藓带回培育。它们最终开出了花——一种在月光下会散发幽蓝荧光的美丽花朵。

她不知道的是，自己无意中唤醒的，是一段影响深远的家族诅咒…………

百年以后，林白白在阁楼的旧木箱里，发现了父亲遗留的笔记本。奇怪的是，笔记本缺页严重，但是线索却指向了星珀庄园。

林白白的父亲是一位受人尊敬的精神科医生，七年前在星珀庄园离奇去世。官方报告说是意外，但笔记本里的线索可能指向了完全不同的真相。

store_data.about_the_game:
Mistbound: Silent Light is a first-person knowledge-based horror where progression isn’t measured by stats, but by your understanding of the world. In this realm, your voice is your only true resource and your greatest curse.

Inside the fog, your voice is power. Use your microphone to cast archaic spells, manipulate the environment, and solve complex puzzles. But remember: every word spoken is a beacon for what moves in the shadows. In Mistbound, knowing the secrets of the fog is the only way out, and communication is a constant risk between life and death.

A World That Responds to Your Voice

The Mistland are a closed, shifting place. To escape, you must understand what keeps you trapped, explore unstable environments, and decide when to speak and when to remain silent.

Learn to improve

Consult your Talking Grimoire, a mysterious entity that will teach you the correct pronunciation of new spells and reveal fragments of a past life. Studying its pages is the only way to face the cursed realm and find an escape route among the secrets of the past.

Truth and Lies

You will explore the contrast between truth and lies. Each spell can reveal or distort reality: speaking the truth shows the world as it is, while lying alters it, changing paths, rules, and possibilities. Choosing between these two sides becomes a core part of the puzzles.

An Experience of Tension and Intuition

Mistbound Silent Light delivers an experience focused on tension, exploration, and puzzles built around both the power and the danger of your voice.

store_data.about_the_game:
Eight years ago, the radio destroyed Roland’s life. Since then, the young farmer has lived his life cut from the world and from himself. Everything changes when, one night, the old station wakes up and lightning rips the sky in half.

In White Week, you travel through a rich 2D world looking for answers and secrets. Your actions are minigames based on four gameplay cores, dexterity, agility, charisma and force. Every key moment takes place during turn-based combats where your choices are made organically through the outcome as well as your skills and your playing style.


Explore an ever changing world.

Discover Roland’s home and its many landscapes as strange events start to reshape it. Find secret passages and open new paths.

Talk with everything that has a voice (or doesn’t).

Encounter curious characters, creatures and… things finding their way into the forest. Whether they are aggressive, peaceful or sometimes ambiguous, it’s up to you to decide how to interact with them.

Face the dangers of the forest… and elsewhere.

Influence the story through turn-based confrontations where outcomes depend on your approach. Will you use violence, fear or the goodness of your heart to go forward, that is if your adversaries let you? Be curious and experiment as you face creatures with their own strange logic. Think carefully, some of your actions could have irreversible consequences.

Do stuff!

Whether it’s gathering dandelions, reasoning a treacherous bird or pushing back against a robot sent by a mysterious power, everything is a minigame. Specialise yourself in one or more gameplay cores, here, there are no statistics! Roland’s skills are yours.

And don’t forget to take care of yourself and those you hold dear. Your mistakes and errors are what makes the story! In White Week, there is no Game Over.

store_data.about_the_game:
Night At The Mall is a first-person, narrative-driven psychological horror game where you take the night shift inside an abandoned shopping mall that refuses to stay still.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT SHIFT

You are trapped. The lights are flickering, the doors are locked, and the static mannequins seem to be getting closer. In this narrative-driven horror game, you must restore power and find a way out before the mall claims you.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Tactile Investigation System

    Clues aren't just UI text. Pick up, rotate, and inspect 3D objects in detail to find hidden keys, codes, or lore. Every item tells a story, and some hold the secrets to your survival

  • Environmental Puzzles

    The mall is falling apart. You'll need to locate specific tools—like a wrench to unbolt rusted shutters—and manage complex electrical systems. Restore power by balancing auxiliary switches and main breakers to progress through the dark

  • CCTV Surveillance

    You can't be everywhere at once. Utilize a functioning Security Camera System to scout ahead. Watch the monitors in the security room to track changes in the environment or spot threats lurking in the dark hallways before you step into them

  • The Unseen Threat

    Paranoia is your enemy. The entities in this mall follow their own rules. Experience dynamic scares where mannequins change positions when your back is turned or when you look away. Keep your eyes open; looking away might be your last mistake

  • Dynamic Atmosphere

    Immerse yourself in a terrifyingly realistic environment. Experience spatial 3D audio, dynamic light failures, flickering power surges, and sanity-bending visual effects that react to your presence

  • Full Controller Support

    Play comfortably with mouse & keyboard or experience the horror with full gamepad support, featuring smooth menu navigation and intuitive interaction mechanics.

store_data.about_the_game:
Adamant Heart is a retro-styled shooting adventure, where you can explore a world filled with mysterious ruins and dangers.

“The Adamant were here before us, and will remain long after we are gone.”

Our world is filled with vast mysterious structures, found all over the land, sea and even up in the sky. Nobody knows who put them there, or what their true purpose is. We only know that they are inhabited by the Adamant— unchanging, ever-present robots of all sizes and shapes that roam without rest. 

And while they mostly keep to themselves, we do occasionally take a bit from them in order to survive. That is the job of an explorer— to venture deep into their territory, and collect treasure that will keep our civilization alive.

  • Ruin Exploration
    Shoot your way through a vast underground network of ruins, filled with autonomous robots known as the Adamant. Fight against all kinds of enemies, bosses, and discover new secrets at every corner.

  • Find parts and treasure
    Collect valuable items from all over the world and upgrade your gear! Build new weapons, complete quests and gain access to even deeper places.

  • Unravel the true purpose
    Uncover all the secrets of the Adamant, in a story that will take you throughout the world and to mysterious new places no one has seen before.

store_data.about_the_game:
Heliostar: Space Galleon is a turn-based combat RPG where you play as the captain of a stellar sailing spaceship.

Guide your ship and crew through adventures of exploration, trade or piracy, in a universe with multiple historical, Lovecraftian and steampunk inspirations.

A galactic adventure

Immerse yourself in a narrative adventure, with multiple mission choices and multiple ways to solve them. Get involved in the ongoing war, or remain neutral. Search for forgotten relics, accept lucrative contracts, or thwart the plans of shadowy agents.

Move your ship around the map while keeping an eye on your supplies. Navigate from star to star to achieve your objectives. Trade, plunder, or expand your interests to the many planets of the galaxy.

Planned turn-based combat, space and ground

Take part in space battles with your galleon or engage in ground combat with your companions. Both types of combat use a planned turn-based system: first, you organize your crew's actions, then, once confirmed, they are automatically resolved alongside those of the enemy.

Upgrade and customize

During the adventure, your crew will gain experience and your hold will fill up with valuable materials, allowing you to upgrade your space enterprise. Develop your companions' skills, unlock new weapons and increase the power of your ship.

You can also add your own personal touch by changing the appearance of your characters, your ship and your flag.

No Up is a first-person liminal exploration game set in disorienting, surreal spaces where traditional orientation and gravity cannot be trusted. Players navigate environments where any surface can be walked on, uncovering the logic of each space through observation, movement, and simple interactions rather than combat or complex systems.

Focused on atmosphere and spatial problem-solving, No Up uses minimal text, fully localized prompts, and event-driven puzzles to create an abstract, immersive experience. The game is deliberately linear and tightly scoped, emphasizing mood, perception, and curiosity over challenge or progression, inviting players to explore strange places and understand how they work—one interaction at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this kingdom, the punishment for gamblers is harsh: they get thrown into the King’s Well, a massive industrial prison from which nobody can escape… something that you, the newest prisoner, intend to prove false with your cunning strategies and card skills. To survive the brutal challenges you will face, you will have to feed the weapons you have gathered on the King’s Well with your cards to trigger attacks, defenses, and special effects to chain powerful combos. Hopefully you will grow strong enough to be able to climb back to the surface. 

Old Machines, Poker Hands, Risk and Reward 

Every time you face a machine you will have different slots you can activate with one card from your hand, and each of these has different effects: from single attacks to increasing your defense, or other special effects like altering your hand that will let you chain incredible combos. Some slots can be activated with whatever card you want; others have specific requirements. 

Every choice counts, though – every turn, the poker hand that you form with your unused cards will grant powerful effects. You can heal with a Pair, get damage and defence bonuses with a Three of a Kind, use a Straight to increase both your offensive and defensive power… These combinations can also grant you gold with which you can improve your run for long-term benefits, so you will need to walk on a thin, razor-sharp line between short-term survival and taking risks to improve your chances of getting out of the King’s Well. 

A Perilous Upward Path

Choose between four different starting gamblers, like the Iron Veteran or the High Roller, each with their own starting weapons. Navigate a procedurally generated map where every stop is different – face enemies, events, and high-risk choices on your way back to freedom. Pick your route carefully: the way forward may be clear, but survival is a long-short bet. Defeat regular and elite enemies to gain new Relics and powerful weapons; take your chances at events, or spend your gold wisely in the Shop to gain permanent upgrades. 

Key Features:

  • 4 Unique Characters: Choose from 4 different gamblers, like The Iron Veteran or The High Roller, each with their own starting weapons.

  • Strategic Machine Combat: Decide when to spend cards on machines and when to hold them for poker combo bonuses.

  • Deep Roguelite Progression: Learn the map, refine your strategy, and discover new builds with every run.

  • Dark Steampunk Atmosphere: Explore a world of rusted gears, shadowy tunnels, and relentless mechanical threats.

Choose between four different starting gamblers, like the Iron Veteran or the High Roller, each with their own starting weapons. Navigate a procedurally generated map where every stop is different – face enemies, events, and high-risk choices on your way back to freedom. Pick your route carefully: the way forward may be clear, but survival is a long-short bet. Defeat regular and elite enemies to gain new Relics and powerful weapons; take your chances at events, or spend your gold wisely in the Shop to gain permanent upgrades. 

Key Features:

  • 4 Unique Characters: Choose from 4 different gamblers, like The Iron Veteran or The High Roller, each with their own starting weapons.

  • Strategic Machine Combat: Decide when to spend cards on machines and when to hold them for poker combo bonuses.

  • Deep Roguelite Progression: Learn the map, refine your strategy, and discover new builds with every run.

  • Dark Steampunk Atmosphere: Explore a world of rusted gears, shadowy tunnels, and relentless mechanical threats.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE FALLEN WILL

The Fallen Will is a top-down atmospheric action and exploration game, plunging you into an underground world where darkness meets light.

You play as an Ublum, an enigmatic creature awakening in the depths of the Chasm. Stripped of your memories, only a mysterious voice urges you to climb. While your first steps are taken in apparent tranquility, the ascent will inexorably darken as you gain altitude, with each tier revealing a little more of this universe's mysteries.

THE ASCENT OF THE CHASM

Leave the depths behind and begin an increasingly grueling journey. Explore singular biomes and forge a path into the unknown. Unlock ancient tunnels to navigate quickly, and establish your makeshift camps. These refuges are true havens of peace, perfect for catching your breath before diving back into the darkness.

SURVIVAL THROUGH MATTER

The ascent requires a minimum of preparation. Upgrade your resting places and craft fragile tools to overcome obstacles. Each broken or sacrificed piece of equipment allows you to forge new ones, better suited to your progression.

THE WEIGHT OF KARMA

The Chasm is alive, and it reacts to your presence. Learn to understand this unpredictable ecosystem and its strange creatures. Your choices towards the environment forge your Karma. This resonance will unlock never-before-seen dialogues, reveal buried locations, and open secret passages for those who know how to listen to this world.

MARKS OF THE PAST

A heart of light wrapped in a body of darkness: such is your burden. Throughout your journey, cross paths with other lost souls. Forge bonds, lend them assistance, and share a part of the way in this limbo.

Something is hidden at the summit of the world... it is up to you to reach it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Luhor's Memory is a roguelike Hack'n Slash where you combat the attack of a vengeful god and his commanders.

Combat System

The game has a fast paced combat system in which an aggressive playstyle is your best way to survival.

You flaunts a shield powered by ambrosia, which flows strongly in your enemies. Any hit on an enemy will empower this shield.

Two melee attack chains carve through close-range encounters.

A dash lets you weave through danger.

Two ranged options eliminate threats from afar.

Devastating special attack combos add deadly versatility.

Lore

A week before the events of this game, the sky breaks open and reveals a massive eye.

This is Feitecheen, a god from a pantheon of eldritch beings.
To these gods, worship manifests as ambrosia: a highly addictive substance they crave.

Humanity however, has recently undergone another renaissance, ushering a new age of peace prosperity and beauty.

The soulless gray boxes of brutalism being torn down and replaced with the beauty and elegance of art nouveau.

With this new era of peace and prosperity, the people have gradually turned away from religion. They want for nothing, and no longer feel the need to pray.

The gods, long accustomed to humanity’s worship, do not accept this silence.

Angered by the absence of worship, one of these gods had decided this was unacceptable. He descended upon the mortal realm and reclaimed the worship through fear.

Project Information

This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year in the bachelor Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium.

The music was composed by Ziggy Sunaert, student at the Royal Conservatoire of Antwerp.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Note from the Developer: I have spent 9 years building The Vanguard Expanse 4065. My goal was to create a game that respects your intelligence, offers a genuine challenge, and absolutely refuses to hold your hand. This is a difficult, complex, but incredibly rewarding incremental strategy RPG. There is no linear path and no "right" way to win. Play however you want, adapt to the universe, and forge your own empire. Good luck, Commander. — JD

SURVIVE. ADAPT. CONQUER.

The year is 4065. Earth is a memory. As the commander of The Vanguard, you are the architect of humanity's survival in a hostile, procedurally evolving universe.

The Vanguard Expanse 4065 is a text-based incremental strategy RPG that fuses deep 4X empire building with infinite procedural progression. This isn't just a game about watching numbers go up; it's about adapting to a galaxy that fights back and changes every time you blink.

PLAY HOWEVER YOU WANT Are you a ruthless warlord? A cunning political mastermind? A shadow-market smuggler, or an industrial tycoon? The choice is entirely up to you. Build your empire your way.

A UNIVERSE GENERATED FOR YOU No two command tenures are alike. You must survive random stellar phenomena and dynamic galactic events. Will you divert power to your shields to survive a corrosive Acid Storm, or risk your hull to salvage a Derelict Ghost Ship drifting through the void?

KEY FEATURES:

  • INFINITE INDUSTRIAL SCALING: Start with a single mining drone and expand into a multi-planetary industrial complex. Research 10,000+ procedural tech levels. Automate the extraction of 20+ resources, from simple Metal to exotic Neutronium and Dark Matter. Build massive Dyson Spheres to harness the power of stars.

  • TACTICAL FLEET COMMAND: You are in the captain's chair. Assemble a fleet of Corvettes, Destroyers, and massive Titans. Engage in active battles. Fight against the Iron Legion, Space Pirates, and the encroaching horror of The Consumption.

  • EVOLUTION & CYBERNETICS: Morality is a luxury you cannot afford. Harvest Biomass from alien kills to mutate your population with Hive Minds. Construct a Cyborg Foundry to build Infiltrator Units for high-risk Black Ops missions involving assassination and sabotage.

  • POLITICS & THE BLACK MARKET: Join the Galactic Parliament. Use Influence to pass galaxy-wide laws—vote for Martial Law to boost your fleet damage, or Free Trade to supercharge your economy. If politics fail, visit the Shadow Exchange to smuggle illegal goods and bribe rival factions.

  • LOGISTICS & HAULING: Manage a complex Logistics Network. Sign contracts for Short Hauls or high-stakes Sector Warps. Risk it all on Smuggler Runs—illegal cargo pays 50x more, but attracts the deadliest pirates in the sector.

  • A LIVING ECONOMY & INFINITE LOOT: Hunt bosses to find flagship modules with randomized affixes (e.g., "Overclocked Hyper-Railgun of the Vampire"). Trade over 1,000 unique procedurally generated commodities like Quantum Silk and Void Spices in a dynamic market simulation.

  • THE OMEGA POINT: When you have conquered this reality, trigger the Ascension. Reset the universe with Prestige mechanics, earning Cosmic Essence to unlock game-breaking permanent upgrades and push further into the unknown in your next life.

The stars are not silent. They are waiting for a commander who won't back down.

The Forbidden Forest is a pixel-art metroidvania videogame, set in a vibrant but mysterious world. Meet powerful allies and fierce adversaries as you uncover the world’s deepest mysteries. Who is this Cub? Who are the bees?

Why does a world's fate rest on a child's shoulders?

Chart a huge metroidvania landscape, with over 25 unique areas to explore, over 30 unique badges to equip, and over 40 challenging and engaging bosses to vanquish. Meet unique characters and learn the mysteries of a world on the edge of collapse.

  • 3 playable characters, with unique moves, powers, and encounters

  • Over 15 powerful abilities to unlock

  • Dozens of creatures and characters to meet

  • Over 40 gripping boss battle encounters

  • 1 special cub to save a dying land

With a lively, upbeat score, and expressive animation, The Forbidden Forest delivers an impactful adventure with a deep and powerful story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rummy Odyssey: The Roguelite Revolution of Classic Rummy

Rummy Odyssey blends Rummy mechanics with modern Roguelite strategy and the excitement of Deckbuilding.

Defeat the luck factor with your strategy, manipulate your deck, and combine powerful Jokers to multiply your points.

This is not just a game where you arrange tiles and finish; it is a strategic journey where you try to form the best combinations to reach the target score in every round.

                         

                                   

🟢 THE GAME MECHANIC IS VERY SIMPLE

No complex rules. Your goal is to group the tiles in your hand and lay them on the table according to three simple rules:

1. Same Numbers: Tiles with the same number but different colors (e.g., Red 7, Blue 7, Black 7).

2. Sequential Numbers: Consecutive numbers in the same color (e.g., Blue 4, 5, 6).

3. Same Color and Number: Keep identical tiles of the same color and number together (e.g., Red 4, Red 4).

Match tiles, collect points, and advance to the next round. But beware: the target score you need to reach increases with every round!

                   

🔥 BREAK THE RULES WITH JOKERS

Just matching the tiles is not enough; you must empower them.

Turn the rules of the game in your favor with special "Joker Cards" you will collect throughout your adventure.

• Scorers: Multiply your score with cards like "Only Red tiles give 2x points" or "Gain extra points if you use even numbers."

• Game Makers: Gain the right to hold more tiles in your hand or unlock more options in the market.

..

                                

🧪 DRİNKS: FRIENDS FOR TOUGH DAYS

Are things not going well?

Are you left with useless tiles in your hand?

Change your fate by using the single-use Drinks in your inventory.

                  

🛠️ CREATE YOUR OWN LUCK

You don't have to rely on chance. With deckbuilding mechanics, manipulate your deck:

- Keep getting bad tiles? Permanently remove them from your deck.

- Start each run with uniquely themed decks featuring different rule sets, bringing fresh strategies to every game.   

                                

👹 CHALLENGE THE BOSSES

The "Boss" levels waiting for you at the end of each section don't just demand high scores; they restrict you.

• "Curse of Odds": Odd-numbered tiles are worth 0 points.

• "Pattern Breaker": The same set cannot be repeated in each hand.

..

        

💰 RISK OR SECURITY?

Should you spend your earned gold immediately to power up, or save it to generate interest income? Managing your economy is just as crucial as managing your tiles. A rich strategy or a full wallet? The choice is yours.   

In Rummy Odyssey, luck is only the beginning victory depends on your strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
RESOURCE COLLECTOR

You send your raiders/companions to gather resources from the various piles of equipment abandoned by the army after its ultimate defeat.

There are several types of resources to collect.

You will need to collect those you will need immediately, such as food and water.

LOYALTY

Loyalty is a very important aspect of the gameplay. If you reach level zero, you lose all credibility and will be driven out by your companions.

LIMITED RESOURCES AND WORKFORCE

You will have to make choices quickly, which will lead you to implement strict resource management.

BASE BUILDING

You will construct buildings as needed. Some are related to the satisfaction of your companions, while others are related to improving productivity in resource collection.

UNLOCKING TECHNOLOGIES

With the tools you've collected from the material piles, you can build a workshop where you can tinker to improve your daily life and, most importantly, obtain the RADIO!

The radio will allow you to build a communication tower that can send SOS signals and attract more survivors to your base.

ELECTRICITY IS ESSENTIAL

In your main building, there is a generator that supplies electricity to all the buildings.

Electricity cannot be stored; it must be produced using oil, which you will find all around your main building.

TOTAL IMMERSION

At any time, you can play as the base commander, EDITH, a woman whose past led her to open this refuge for the survivors of this post-apocalyptic world dominated by robots. You can then play in third-person view and fight alongside your companions against the enemies.

COMBAT AGAINST THE CYBORGS

The cyborgs will attack you regularly, but you'll be warned by an increased alert level shortly before the assault.

You'll need to activate combat mode, which will allow you to take direct control of your companions to lead the battle and protect the base.

ULTIMATE OBJECTIVE: SURVIVE

Survive all cyborg attacks in the region before you can declare yourself FREE!

store_data.about_the_game:
Party Pong is a 2-4 player online multiplayer beer pong party game with a action card twist. Sink clutch shots, draw ridiculous cards, and turn every round into a full-blown chaotic experience. Whether you’re sweating for the win or shooting for fun, one thing’s guaranteed someone’s getting cooked.

CLASSIC BEER PONG WITH A TWIST

Line up your shots and turn into a pong legend... Every made cup can swing momentum with buffs, curses, distractions, and absolute nonsense. It’s beer pong… but strategy and chaos are always one card away.

ACTION CARDS

Use a growing arsenal of cards to boost your shots, sabotage your opponents, bend the rules, and create highlight-reel moments.
From clean power-ups to “who approved this?” curse cards, every match turns into a new story. 

   

ONLINE CO-OP

Play your way. Party Pong supports 2 to 4 players, Start a match with friends or hop into a quick match either way it’s loud, competitive, friendship threatening energy.

DISRUPT, DISTRACT, DOMINATE

Talk your trash and back it up. Trigger distractions, mess with your opponent’s focus, and create the kind of moments that will make your whole party scream. Winning is great… but winning while being toxic is better.

BEER PONG FEATURES

Redemption

Redemption gives you one last chance to clutch up and fight your way back into the game. If your team is down to the final cup and your opponent sinks it, you have the opportunity to hit a shot of your own to stay in the game.

Bouncing

A single bounce can instantly change the game. Bouncing rewards players with 2 cups!! 

Heating Up / On Fire

Heating Up and On Fire turns streaks. Hitting consecutive shots makes your team enter a powered-up state where you shoot until you miss.

Death Cup

store_data.about_the_game:
Manage your factory, watch numbers grow, and improve it endlessly.

Dumbers is an automation game where you extract numbers, process them with math operations, and deliver to the Hub to progress through infinite levels. Focus on building and refining your factory step by step.

KEY FEATURES

15 UNIQUE BUILDINGS

• 5 Extractor Tiers (T1 to elite T5)

• Mathematical processors that add and multiply the collected items (Adders, Incrementers, Doublers, Triplers, Quadruplers)

• Transport & Logistics (Belts, Express Belts, Mergers, Splitters)

No complex math needed: relax as numbers multiply and flow through your factory.

SYNERGY & STRATEGY SYSTEM

Smart design beats brute force. Processor placement matters:

• Synergy Bonuses: Chain processors strategically for up to +30% bonuses (ADDER → MULTIPLIER, INCREMENTER → ADDER, ADDER CHAINS, MIXED combinations)

• Diminishing Returns: The more processors a resource passes through, the smaller the gain from each one — and longer chains also become slower. Optimize your production lines wisely!

• Dynamic Penalties: Excessive splitters, mergers, and logistics abuse reduce final output at the Hub

• Real-time Feedback: Visual indicators show efficiency and penalties as numbers flow through your factory

Build diverse, efficient layouts instead of spamming the same buildings.

STRATEGIC CHOICES

Resources have dual use: level up to unlock new buildings, or invest in permanent upgrades for production boosts. Every choice enhances your factory's efficiency.

11 UPGRADE PATHS

Boost extraction speed, cut processing time, speed up belts, and more. Unlock bonuses like Lucky Extractor (2x random values) and Processor Efficiency (extra outputs). Each path has 5 progressive levels.

RELAXED GAMEPLAY

• Pause anytime for planning

• Color-coded buildings with efficiency indicators

• Satisfying particle effects and animations

• Idle progression—factory runs while away

• Multiple save slots and auto-save

• Are you tired of placing buildings, or have you reached high levels and the resources you obtain no longer matter? Press Z and admire Zen Mode as you travel through numbers!

INFINITE PROGRESSION

15+ levels with growing targets. Beyond level 15, challenges scale infinitely.

Design efficient layouts. Discover optimal synergy combinations. Master the balance between diversity and optimization in your factory.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Apartment is a first-person psychological horror
where a familiar space begins to live by someone else’s rules.

You wake up in your apartment. At first glance, everything looks the same: the same rooms, the same objects, the same silence. But only at first glance. A strange feeling won’t leave you, as if something has changed.

Suddenly, the silence is shattered by a deafening siren. The countdown has already begun. But what will happen when the time runs out?

In the bedroom, the computer is on. On the screen a code input window.

And then you hear a voice: It demands that you enter the code.

The siren keeps drilling into your ears, making it impossible to concentrate. You don’t understand what is happening or why it’s happening to you.

When the timer reaches zero, the air begins to change. It becomes heavier, denser, and somewhere beyond the walls you hear a quiet, almost imperceptible hiss.

It’s gas.

It slowly fills the apartment.

The apartment is full of details that once seemed insignificant. Hidden compartments, notes, cryptic codes, forgotten objects… All of them are pieces of a puzzle whose meaning you have yet to understand.

Old VHS cameras are watching your every step.

Returning to familiar rooms and discovering new fragments, you begin to see the bigger picture. The apartment holds the answers — but it won’t give them up easily.

Uncover what happened.

And find a way out before it’s too late.

By any means necessary.

Inspired by classic psychological horror and the aesthetics of analog horror and VHS.

store_data.about_the_game:
LUCID DREAM

A Skill-Driven Top-Down Action Game

You awaken in a fractured dream world with no clear explanation of how you arrived.
Armed with a single weapon, you must move through hostile environments and confront powerful entities blocking your path.

Core Gameplay
Lucid Dream is a top-down action game focused on player control, positioning, and timing.
Progress is earned through observation, adaptation, and consistent execution rather than statistics or automated assistance.

World and Exploration
The dream kingdom is built from rigid structures and distorted logic.
Levels are designed to remain readable under pressure, allowing players to assess threats and react quickly.

Combat Flow
Encounters are fast and demanding.
Success depends on movement, spacing, and timing rather than numerical advantage.

Pressure and Opposition
Enemies apply constant pressure, forcing players to read attack patterns, identify openings, and commit decisively.

Guardians
As you progress, increasingly formidable guardians stand in your way.
These encounters emphasize pattern recognition, composure, and precise execution.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the near future, the standards for human enjoyment are becoming increasingly demanding, and people constantly seek more stimulating content. To meet these heightened expectations, entertainment companies have launched the 'Unit League', a competitive tournament where participants battle each other using various weapons. As a player, you will take charge of managing one of these teams.

 Recruit units needed for your team and deploy them appropriately. Strengthen your team by leveling them up and equipping them, win battles, and achieve good results in the league.

 Basically, combat is played from a third-person perspective, where you choose to 'directly control' one member from your entire team. For league matches, you can select and field 25 team members and support a 'spectator mode' where you watch without any control.

 Each unit type is divided into Mace, Dagger, Greatsword, Greataxe, Dual (Dual Wield), Pistol, Shotgun, Launcher, Rifle, and Sniper, and there is a basic stat difference depending on the type.

 You can earn in-game money (c) and reputation by participating in League Matches, Mini-Games, the Arena, and Bounty Hunts. In-game money can be used to purchase equipment from the shop or recruit players. As your reputation increases, the in-game money you receive from participating in league matches increases, and the rewards you get for clearing mini-games also increase.

 Scientific Capability (f) can be obtained as a final reward at the end of a league season, by disassembling items, or by analyzing street waste. In the Lab, you can use Scientific Capability to raise the level of functions that help with gameplay.

 Items can be obtained by purchasing them from the shop or by going out into the Restricted Area to hunt and explore

◆ Experience

This game allows you to control a "Hakorobo" and enjoy various actions using boxes.

Experience a variety of box-based actions.

Grab the box and smash it into your opponent. The action is very simple and intuitive.

The controls are easy, so even those who aren't good at action games can enjoy the action of "HAKOTOREE"

◆Single Player

Stages are available where you can experience the action of "HAKOTOREE"

Use various box-related actions to clear the stage.

Experience the single-player stages and you'll naturally become accustomed to controlling "Hakorobo."

*Online multiplayer will be unlocked once you complete Stage 1.

◆Story

"Talos Realm" is a realm in the corner of virtual space.

Its inhabitants, the "Hakorobo," live happily in eternal time.

A mysterious computer virus suddenly breaks out, infecting the "Hakorobo" and causing them to lose their sense of self.

They are about to be sent into the real world as soldiers.

By chance, the carefree "Hakorobo" dozes off and avoids infection.

He sets out to find the "Reset Switch" deep within the world to save the world from crisis.

◆Online Multiplayer

"HAKOTOREE" supports online multiplayer.

Split into Blue Team and Red Team, players compete to capture boxes and score points.

Enjoy the simple yet profound action of using boxes with everyone.

*Once you complete all single-player stages, you'll be able to play under Battle Royale rules.

store_data.about_the_game:
BREAKING NEWS: There have been a record number of break-in murders to homes in the surrounding area.

WARNING: STAY INDOORS and DON'T open the door.

You play as George and you live with your parents and only brother in a remote cabin deep in the mountains. A brutal snowstorm sweeps through the area and stops your parents from coming home for the night. You boys grow hungry and your brother decides to make a bold decision:

GOING OUT TO GET PIZZA.

Despite the warnings, your brother moves forward with his decision, and you are left home alone awaiting his return. As time passes by, things happen that begin to question your reality.

TO ANSWER OR NOT TO ANSWER

Several visitors knock on the door throughout the night. Can you trust the knocks?

UNLOCK PUZZLES AND PLAY GAMES

Pass the time by playing George's favorite games and crack secret codes.

TRUST YOUR INSTINCTS

Pay attention to what your hear and see. Your choices will shape how the night ends.

Knock is a short story psychological horror game focused on atmosphere, tension, and unease. As George tries to pass some time while Brian is out getting dinner, strange things begin to happen. Will he survive the night and get his pizza?

Key Features:
• PSX-inspired low-poly visuals and retro rendering
• Spatial & directional sound design
• Interactive environment and puzzles
• Short, focused experience with replayability
• Multiple endings shaped by the choices you make

store_data.about_the_game:
Listening to Nature's Voice: A Quiet Adventure

A Healing Exploration Adventure Through Forest and Soul

Qualial Nature is

a gentle exploration experience connecting with nature and purifying the forest.

Players visit the forest and encounter Anima (souls) of land, sea, and sky.

With the Anima's power, solve nature's troubles one by one,

gradually guiding the forest back to its true form.

No fighting. No rushing.

Simply listen to the voice of nature.

――――――――――

【Story】

※Space for story content here

(Example: Why the protagonist came to the forest / How they encounter the Anima, etc.)

――――――――――

＜Game Features＞

◆ Encountering Anima and the Power of Purification

Explore the forest, sea, and treetops to find Anima.

Each Anima possesses the power to heal nature.

By utilizing each Anima's unique traits, you can explore the forest more comfortably and freely.

◆ Communicate with Nature Through Anima

Acquiring Anima allows players to hear nature's voice.

Successful purification may prompt the forest, water, or wind to respond with “thank you.”

You won't be told where impurities lie—it's crucial to seek them out, notice them, and act with your own feet.

It feels like conversing with nature not through words, but through your heart.

◆ Free-Roaming, Nonlinear Exploration

There is no set order.

Visit places that catch your interest freely and proceed with purification at your own pace.

◆ A Gentle Game Experience Without Combat

This game contains no battles.

It is a game that values quiet time spent connecting with nature.

◆ The Forest Landscape Gradually Transforms

As purification progresses, the forest regains its original beauty.

Witnessing this change is one of the game's greatest charms.

store_data.about_the_game:
What a peaceful day! As the sun sets and the moon begins to shine its light over the village, a young witch finishes her busy day of potion making by hanging her hat and going to bed. Her cat, Mona, doesn't want to go to bed though. She's more interested in the treats the Witch left out! But things don't go as planned when the Witch's hat falls on Mona's head and everything comes to life. Now she has to turn everything back to normal!

Mona and the Witch's Hat Deluxe is a homebrew game made for the Game Boy Color, and is a remake of the original Mona and the Witch's Hat from 2018. This "Deluxe" or "DX" version of Mona and the Witch's Hat features a brand new soundtrack, full color graphics, and new animations. It features the same four levels as the original version, and can be completed in about 20 minutes.

Made using GBDK and Zal0's ZGB, a small game engine for making Game Boy homebrew games.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neon Survivor

【Welcome, Agent. Your consciousness has been synced to Security Protocol Level 0.】

In the neon-drenched megacity of "Night City," the foundational architecture has collapsed. Tens of thousands of rogue drones, defected bio-skeletons, and highly evolved tactical mechs are purging the streets. As a mercenary wandering the edge of the rules, your only way to survive is to—Fight, Loot, and completely Reconstruct your flesh.

Core Features:

  • Ultimate Cyber-Roguelike Thrill:
    Experience the purest "mowing down" satisfaction. Weave through tides of mechanical legions and unleash devastating firepower with automated fire control systems. Every run is a fresh challenge; every second is an overclocked surge on the brink of life and death.

  • Deep Augmentation Lab:
    In the tactical workshop, use collected parts to permanently enhance "Structural Optimization," "Weapon Damage," "Turbo Boost," and "Sync Regulation." Unlock and equip up to 10 core module slots to build your ultimate killing machine.

  • Construct Your Tactical Protocols:

    • Focusing Lens: Compresses barrages into high-energy laser beams that slice through metal.

    • Chain Lightning Coil: Releases chain lightning that leaps between enemies in a devastating discharge.

    • Echoing Ballistics: Leaves delayed spatio-temporal shockwaves in the wake of every bullet.

    • Gravity Field: Distorts the surrounding spacetime, suppressing enemy movement with intense gravitational force.

    More and more~~~~

  • Black Market Modules & Loot System:
    Scavenge rare "Parts" during combat and head to the Black Market for legendary-grade modules. Mix and match across Barrel, Ballistics, Warhead, and Shield categories to trigger chain reactions and achieve tactical Overload.

  • Audio-Visual Sensory Feast:
    Immerse yourself in a gritty neon pixel world driven by retro-synth dynamic rhythms. Feel the repression and madness of the Cyber era in every heartbeat.

【Warning: System integrity reduced to 40%. Prepare for Overload Shock.】

【Agent, execute protocol. Purge all unstable variables.】

store_data.about_the_game:
Selfie Worm is a visually rewarding 2D physics platformer. Take control of a bouncy, elastic worm and leap through a monochrome alien world. Feel the pure joy of every collision and rebound in a stress-free environment designed for ultimate flow—no pressure, no failure, just pure relaxation.

In this world of stark black and white outlines, your camera is the only key to bringing back the warmth. By capturing photos from the worm’s unique perspective, you’ll not only repaint the environment but also unlock hidden narrative fragments. These snippets reveal touching, heartwarming moments waiting to be discovered.

Designed with a unique vertical window mode, the game mimics a mobile selfie experience while tucking neatly beside your work windows. It’s the perfect "healing" companion for your breaks. Features include:

  • 【Boss Key】: Professional Camouflage Mode. Double-tap ESC to instantly switch to a realistic calculator interface for those "unexpected" situations.

  • 【Productivity Tools】: Built-in Pomodoro Timer and Music Player. Let the worm keep you company during every focused work session.

  • 【Zero-Stress Micro-Breaks】: Levels are designed in 1-minute bursts—pick it up and put it down anytime to match your workflow.

Collect various worm skins and camera filters to create your own unique social-ready photos.

Don't let your computer be worm-less! Add Selfie Worm to your Wishlist now for the latest dev updates and Demo news!

store_data.about_the_game:
Freyline is a roguelike deckbuilder RPG set in the fantasy realm of Leodin, named after the titular maiden.

Recently a mysterious spell has caused all beings to be consumed with lust, for the chaste order of Leo and Vesper this is something of an annoyance. However Battle Maiden Freyline has been despatched westwards to close the rift and conclude the insane levels of debauchery. 

In Freyline you help our hero by building a deck, navigating branching paths, and survive a series of deadly encounters where victory can be achieved through brutal damage or by overwhelming your enemies through arousal and corruption... which might be easier but Leo and Vesper will likey not look kindly on. Every choice pushes you closer toward one of two destinies and neither path is clean.

Combat is fast, tactical, and deeply replayable (I hope), blending familiar deckbuilding fundamentals with a dual-resource system that rewards risk-taking, restraint, or deliberate imbalance... of find a sick build that breaks the game because it is fun to break things.

Core Gameplay

  • Card-based combat inspired by modern roguelike deckbuilders

  • Two parallel victory conditions:

    • Damage victories through HP reduction

    • Arousal victories that force enemies to.. lose control

  • Manage HP, arousal, energy, card draw, and long-term corruption

  • Enemies telegraph intent, forcing strategic sequencing rather than brute force

  • Every battle is a choice between safety, speed, and temptation

Corruption, Choice, and Consequence

Power in Freyline always comes at a cost.

As corruption spreads, It unlocks new cards, events, and routes. with new doors opening other shut. Lean too far in either direction and your run begins to shape itself around your decisions, often irreversibly.

  • Corruption and purity influence events, cards, and endings

  • Optional events can grant powerful advantages or lasting consequences

  • Loss of control, possession, and temptation are recurring narrative themes

  • Multiple endings ... well 2... but they will be good I promice

Features

  • Procedurally generated runs with branching paths

  • A growing card pool supporting multiple playstyles

  • Distinct enemy archetypes with unique weaknesses

  • Events, secrets, and cursed encounters

  • Optional visual filters to reduce explicit imagery

  • High replayability with short, intense runs

store_data.about_the_game:
Slendyjan is a fast-paced first-person action experience that blends high-speed combat with a dark, story-driven setting, encouraging players to stay aggressive, stay alert, and survive long enough to uncover the reality behind the war.

Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player follows Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary fighting alongside the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown world.

Years ago, the Nuggets arrived on Earth with a proposal for peace: an exchange of advanced technology in return for the energy required to sustain their species. The agreement was accepted by Humans and Mushrooms, but as tensions grew, the balance between factions collapsed and war became inevitable.

As Jan is sent deeper into hostile territories, combat becomes relentless and survival depends on constant movement, sharp reflexes, and decisive action. The world does not wait for the player to slow down, and hesitation is often punished.

Progression unfolds through intense encounters and carefully designed environments where mastery comes from learning enemy behavior, adapting on the fly, and maintaining momentum. Each area challenges the player to push forward while uncovering fragments of the truth behind the conflict.

store_data.about_the_game:
You just quit your job after your boss insulted your favorite childhood mascot. Now you are broke, bitter, and stuck in a train station with nothing but a sad sandwich and a tacky suit. Then a rich, sweet, and painfully clueless tourist mistakes you for a private tour guide—and for some reason, you go along with it.

Later, in a desperate attempt to cheer yourself up, you visit the cafe that’s home to Comfort Kuma, the pink bear mascot who got you through the worst parts of growing up. But during a chaotic parade accident, the mascot’s head comes off. And the guy inside… is really, really cute. Love doesn’t knock when you’re ready. Sometimes it shows up in the form of a lost himbo with a camera… or a man who wears a pink bear suit for a living. You are unemployed, underdressed, and absolutely not qualified for this mess.

Good luck.

Riku Hoshino

Julian Beaumont

  • MC with selectable pronouns

store_data.about_the_game:
Card Chess is a free and open-source online PvP strategy game blending classic chess with card gameplay. Inspired by chess and Magic: The Gathering, each player starts with just a king and a custom 60-card deck that lets you deploy pieces, destroy enemy pieces, draw cards, and tactically control the board.

In every match, strategic card play and traditional chess movement combine: use cards to influence piece deployment and board state, then move your pieces wisely to trick your opponent and even to capture their king directly.

Current 2026 Q2 Release Scope
• Direct PvP linking game play.
• One shared pre-set 60-card deck per match ensures balanced play for all.
• Full open-source access — no fees, no ads, no paywalls.

Future Plans
• Deck Editor & New Cards – Once the community hits ~500 total games played, new cards and a deck building system will be added to the game development plan
• Expansion & Refactor – As the player base grows, the game could expand with more mechanics, content, and deeper strategic options — all remaining open and freely accessible.

Wishlist today and join the the discord group!

store_data.about_the_game:
Awaken in the Homeland of Sin, Seek the Meaning of the Blade

In the distant past, on an island shrouded in dense mist, four sinners made a pact with the gods to establish the "Kingdom of Silence." But with the outbreak of the "Sin-Dragon War," the balance between good and evil was shattered. The Sin-Dragons vanished, and the malice within human hearts—now without a vessel—began to fester and mutate within their flesh.

The Imperial Capital is sealed, and the Four Gods have descended once more. Amidst the ruins, an "Unfated One" with a shattered soul and no memory slowly opens their eyes...

Game Features & Gameplay

  • The Journey of a Shattered Soul Play as Slo, a taciturn knight. Explore the crumbling ruins of the Kingdom of Silence and experience a journey of displacement and hardship. You seek not only the truth behind the kingdom’s fall but also the recovery of your own agonizing memories. Defeat enemies whose sanity has been twisted by obsession, claim their souls, and use them as sustenance to grow stronger.

  • Encounter Diverse Characters Though you will spend most of your journey exploring alone, you may cross paths with eccentric characters along the way. In this desolate world, you are not truly alone.

  • Challenging Interconnected World & Enemies Exploration in the Kingdom of Silence is filled with "Soulslike" peril—but please, don’t give up, skeleton! Find the right approach, master your combat techniques, and overcome the seemingly invincible foes that stand in your way.

  • Develop Your Own Gear, Covenants, and Builds With a vast array of weapons, equipment, covenants, and stat distributions, the possibilities are endless. Each combination offers a distinct gameplay experience. Want to complete the game using only items? Anything is possible.

store_data.about_the_game:
Oathwood Realms is an atmospheric strategy card game focused on meaningful decisions rather than reflexes or execution speed. From the outset, the game has been shaped with player-versus-player gameplay as its long-term goal. Competitive PvP is planned to become the core of the full game.

Each match is driven by intent and tension. Players summon and interact with figures tied to the suits Heart, Spade, and Club. Cards interact in subtle ways, resources are limited, and many decisions unfold over several turns. Chance plays a role, but it never acts alone. Progress comes from reading the situation, weighing risks, and committing to choices without full certainty.

The game keeps explanations intentionally light. Instead of long tutorials, a small number of optional hints appear during play. Mechanics are meant to be understood through experimentation and observation.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE MAIN STORY

The main character of ARTMESS is a girl named Maya. She lives in a small town, in a regular old house, and she’s desperately trying to get her parents back together. Then, one day, a mysterious creature shows up to help her - it looks like a glowing blue blob.

Together, they run away to an amazing but rapidly fading world of Slavic folklore, searching for something that could help fix her parents’s relationship. There, the heroes will meet incredible characters, uncover the secrets of this place, and fight off the darkness that’s been trying to swallow everything up for ages!

KEY FEATURES

- Classic hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation

-A story that will make you think about the complexities of life.

-A variety of beautiful locations. Each chapter of the game features recognizable but distorted fairy-tale biomes filled with battles, obstacles, and secrets. Explore the locations carefully to find secrets and lost Maya drawings!

-Unique environmental mechanics for each biome, which are inhabited by various fairy-tale creatures. Some of them will help you on your adventure, while others will become obstacles.

-Challenging levels, dynamic combat, and boss battles!

With the help of her new friend, Maya will discover the abilities of the higher beings who inhabit these lands to fight evil, but it won't be only the forces of light that will aid her.

The darkness threatens to destroy this world, but Maya and her faithful companion will do everything possible to recover what was stolen and help cleanse it of the forces of evil.

You are Sam. A veteran. A father. A man broken by the system. After the tragic death of his son, a shattered marriage, and job loss born of despair, Sam finds himself on the unforgiving streets of Los Angeles—one of countless forgotten souls in the shadow of the sprawling metropolis.

Scavenge dumpsters for resources, beg for temporary work, and manage your decaying physical health alongside crushing psychological trauma. Seek shelter from the dangers of the night. Your morals will be tested at every turn—will you help others, focus solely on your own survival, or exploit the weak to get ahead?

In a system that remembers your every move, every decision shapes Sam's fate. Can you guide him to a glimpse of redemption, or will the street claim another lost soul?

  • Meaningful Moral Dilemmas: Your actions have lasting consequences, altering relationships, opportunities, and leading to multiple endings.

  • Dynamic Street Ecology: Interact with a living city comprised of fellow homeless, indifferent citizens, authorities, and hidden dangers.

  • Build a Makeshift Home: Slowly transform a forgotten corner into a fragile sanctuary against the chaos.

The city never sleeps; it just waits to consume the next lost soul. Will it be you?
