Press One is a short incremental game where you press one to make money, unlock more keys and upgrade your keyboard. As you unlock more keys, type words around your keyboard to activate insane buffs and multipliers.

What starts as a simple clicking game quickly evolves into a strategic typing challenge. Watch your earnings skyrocket as you optimize your keyboard layout, chain together word combos, and unlock powerful upgrades.

Start Earning with a Single Key

You begin your money-making journey with only the "ONE" key available on your keyboard. Press it repeatedly to generate income, everything in the game depends on this key.

Expand Your Keyboard

Spend your earnings to unlock additional keys scattered across your keyboard. Each new key allows you to press more keys to make more money.

Power Up Your Keys

Invest your money into upgrading individual keys with special abilities. These enhancements boost your earning potential and unlock new strategic options.

Master Word Combos for Massive Gains

Type the words that flash on the screen to earn extra money and build combo streaks, which multiply all income.

Automate Your Income

Purchase automation upgrades that press keys for you. Let your keyboard generate passive income while you focus on typing words and building combos.

Prestige and Unlock Permanent Upgrades

Reset your progress to earn prestige points that can be spent in a skill tree. These permanent bonuses carry over to future runs, making each playthrough more powerful than the last.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this turn-based card game, you can expect short, tactical runs with high replayability. At the beginning, you choose one of several heroes, each with their own stats and a unique passive ability that significantly influences your playing style.

Then you put together your personal ability set: from an ever-changing selection, you gradually choose a total of 10 abilities. Every decision counts – synergies, timing, and adapting to upcoming opponents are the keys to success.

Before each battle, you consciously choose an opponent whose abilities and behavior determine the course of the battle. In battle, your abilities are played alternately, ensuring exciting, dynamic duels.

Between runs, you can buy packs in the shop, unlock new cards, and constantly expand your strategic repertoire. Perfect for short sessions – but with enough depth for long-term motivation.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Manor is in order.
The reports check out.
Reality is secondary.

Operation: Manor is a provocative, satirical online multiplayer game where the goal is not to uncover the truth, but to maintain appearances.

You work in an isolated facility on the plains, one that everyone must believe serves agricultural purposes.
Even when it becomes obvious that it doesn’t.

GAMEPLAY

The game consists of multiplayer matches built around hidden roles, where players receive different tasks and objectives.

The System Operators are responsible for keeping the agricultural facility  or rather, its appearance running:
maintenance, inspections, administrative duties, handling reports.

The Traitors do not sabotage openly.
Their goal is to expose the system’s internal tensions, disrupt its processes, and crack the illusion without being clearly revealed.

Players are constantly forced to make decisions:

Do you cooperate because that’s what’s expected?

Do you suspect something, but stay silent?

Or do you actively contribute to keeping everything running exactly as it is?

KEY FEATURES

  • Online multiplayer with hidden roles

  • Task-based gameplay focused on maintaining appearances

  • Social manipulation and tension, with no clear good or evil side

  • Political and social satire without explicit statements

  • Eastern European–inspired atmosphere, absurd yet familiar

  • Each match unfolds differently based on roles and player decisions

There is no good side here.
Only roles.

Operation: Manor makes no claims.
It does not accuse.
It simply functions.

The question is not what is true.
It’s how long you’re willing to assist in pretending it is.

So — are you coming?
I assume not on foot.

store_data.about_the_game:
Train for the Ritual. Embrace the Darkness. Summon the Goddess.

Runeomicon: Training Room is a free companion game to Runeomicon designed to help you master the most demanding part of the ritual: drawing runes under pressure.

This standalone experience lets you practice rune drawing without enemy waves, resource pressure, or ritual failure. Train different rune difficulty levels, improve your speed and precision, and build muscle memory before stepping into the full game.

Runeomicon: Training Room is not a demo of the full game. It is a tool. A place to experiment, practice, and understand how runes truly work before the ritual begins.

Three Training Modes to Sharpen Your Skills

Custom Mode

Choose exactly which runes you want to practice. Focus on specific tiers or individual runes to improve precision, consistency, and muscle memory. Custom Mode is ideal for isolating weaknesses and mastering difficult patterns at your own pace.

Free Mode

Practice with randomly generated runes drawn from the available pool. Free Mode simulates the unpredictability of the full ritual, helping you adapt quickly and maintain control as different runes appear without warning.

Time Mode

A pressure-focused version of Free Mode with a time limit. Draw as many runes as possible before time runs out, then review a summary showing how many runes you completed successfully and how many you failed. Designed to test speed, accuracy, and consistency under pressure.

The Training Room Is Built for Mastery

Runeomicon: Training Room allows you to practice runes up to Tier 3, with 16 unique runes per tier. Higher-tier runes are more demanding and reward cleaner execution, preparing you for the escalating pressure of the full ritual.

store_data.about_the_game:
There is no clean beginning here.

NO CLEAN START is a single-player psychological survival experience built around repetition, failure, and learning.

You are not meant to win on your first attempt.
You are meant to observe, adapt, and try again — changed.

The Experience

The world reacts to what you do.
It remembers your actions, your mistakes, and your patterns.

Each run reshapes the experience, not through numbers or upgrades, but through understanding.

Design Philosophy

NO CLEAN START avoids traditional hand-holding.
There is no excessive HUD, no explicit guidance, and no power fantasy.

Information is earned through attention, not tutorials.
Failure is expected — and often necessary.

Structure

The game is built around repeated attempts.

Death is not a restart.
It is a continuation — carrying knowledge, consequences, and subtle changes forward.

Development Status

NO CLEAN START is currently in active development.

A playable demo is planned for February.
Development is being shared openly, with frequent updates and transparent design decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
While exploring the walls of an ancient pyramid, when it seemed the place held nothing more than the dust of bygone eras, tragedy strikes. Weakened by time and oblivion, the stone floor of the courtyard collapses, and your companion vanishes deep beneath the earth. Determined to save them, you descend into the pyramid — unaware that you have just awakened something that should never have been disturbed.

Depengate draws you into a world of puzzles, secrets, and rising tension, where every step may have consequences. Players are separated by space, perspective, and information — you see different things, have access to different mechanisms, and hear different sounds. Only through close cooperation and precise communication can you move forward.

What is Depengate?

  • A cooperative game for two players: solving puzzles requires two people, and each player has a role to play.

  • Mysterious locations: explore the corridors and labyrinths of an ancient pyramid.

  • A multitude of puzzles: talk to each other and share what you see and hear to escape this thrilling digital escape room.

Will you and your partner manage to survive in a world where every symbol may be a clue and every decision the beginning of a catastrophe? Or will your attempt at cooperation be the spark that leads to irreversible events?

WARNING: The game is strictly cooperative. An internet connection and voice communication between players are required — either directly or via a voice chat application.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tidal Break is a single-player discovery puzzle roguelite where you uncover the forgotten history of a mysterious island by combining elemental fish to create new elements.

The Island's Secret

The island was never meant to be found again.

The aquariums are cracked. The breeding chambers are silent. Strange machinery lines the walls, purpose unknown. Whoever was here left in a hurry. Or didn't leave at all.

And then there are the fish.

They shimmer with elemental energy. Fire. Water. Air. Earth. They shouldn't exist. But when you combine them, something happens. Something the island remembers.

The tide is rising...

Gameplay

Catch, combine, and experiment with fish imbued with elemental properties. Each successful combination unlocks new fish and reveals fragments of the island's past. Piece together what happened as you work toward the truth.

Features

  • Unique fish to discover through elemental combinations

  • Roguelite progression that persists between runs

  • Environmental storytelling that unfolds as you experiment

  • Single-player experience

Inspired by the satisfying discovery loops of combination games like Doodle God and Little Alchemy, reimagined with narrative depth and 3D presentation.

store_data.about_the_game:
First Class Rescue is the story of Bekka the Bokka, a postal squirrel working to save the stranded residents of Pine Peaks.

When Bekka took a routine shipment to the residents of Pine Peaks, she did not expect to be trapped there; a storm destroyed all viable mountain paths, cutting Bekka and the mountain’s residents off from the rest of society. Help Bekka search for the residents of the mountain and work together with them to repair the signal tower at the peak of the mountain to call for aid.

Climb the mountain and find the residents to restore your home camp, forging your path ahead in this physics-based puzzle platformer. By climbing to new heights and saving the inhabitants of Pine Peaks, Bekka and the community work together to restore their home and bring life back to the trail!

-GAMEPLAY-

Each new resident that you save provides different resources and upgrades that will help further the journey up the mountain! Some of these include:

  • Backpack upgrades

  • Dynamic building blocks

  • Unlockable shops

  • More quests

  • More physics based puzzles

  • New ways to play

-STYLE-

  • Hand-drawn illustrated levels and characters

  • Inspired by US national parks, postal services and Japanese porters

  • Organic and cosy original soundtrack with folky acoustic instrumentation

store_data.about_the_game:
Power is never free.

In this fast-paced action roguelike, you fight your way through cursed halls while accepting gifts from forgotten gods. Each blessing makes you stronger — but every gift comes with a hidden cost.

Master brutal melee combat, dash through enemy attacks, and build powerful synergies as the gods shape your fate… whether you want it or not.

Every run is a test of skill, risk, and choice.

Fast, Skill-Driven Combat

Combat is immediate, responsive, and unforgiving.

  • Fluid melee combos with precise timing

  • Dash, dodge, and reposition to survive overwhelming odds

  • Enemies react to your hits — stagger, break, and fall

  • Boss fights that demand awareness, not button-mashing

Victory comes from mastery, not grinding.

Divine Powers with Consequences

Choose your gods carefully.

Each god grants unique abilities that dramatically alter how you play — from devastating elemental strikes to powerful passive effects. But divine power is never pure.

  • Gain blessings that reshape your build

  • Stack abilities to create powerful synergies

  • Face unexpected consequences as your devotion grows

What the gods give, they may also take away.

Roguelike Structure, Meaningful Progress

Death is not the end — it is part of the journey.

  • Procedurally structured encounters

  • Short, intense runs designed for replayability

  • Unlock new powers and possibilities with each attempt

  • Experiment with different builds every run

Adapt, learn, and return stronger.

store_data.about_the_game:
🎯 BattleVox — Large-Scale Battle Royale FPS

BattleVox is a battle royale multiplayer focused shooter delivering intense combat, where players fight until the last man standing. Each game supports up to 100 player encounters in competitive matches designed around positioning, movement, and survival.

🌍 Maps, Scale & Combat

Engage in battles across large, big, and massive maps, featuring open world layouts built for scale. Every map supports varied modes, dynamic systems, and evolving combat scenarios that keep each experience fresh from drop to endgame.

🕹️ Online or Offline Play

Play multiplayer online in pvp encounters against real opponents, or enjoy a singleplayer solo experience without internet fully offline against AI-controlled enemies with full progression enabled, progression is shared between online and offline modes. Fight bots, bot units, adaptive ai, intelligent enemies, or the computer, with or without matchmaking, in fully playable sessions designed to work online or offline.

🧍 Character Customization & Progression

Customize your soldier with deep character progression built for long-term play. Unlock new visual styles, gear options, and unique looks as you survive more battles and improve performance. Progression is persistent and directly tied to your playstyle, whether you focus on aggressive combat, smart positioning, or survival.

Every match contributes to meaningful, rewarding progression.

🔫 Progression, Loot & Practice

BattleVox features a flexible loot system built for long-term games. Improve through practice, training, and warmup options, choose competitive or casual playstyles, and progress through ranked or non ranked paths as an alternative approach to standard shooters.

🎨 Visual Style & Development

The game uses a stylized, low poly, cubic, minimalist look that stays readable during fast paced action while remaining relaxed outside combat. Built as an indie project in early access, development focuses on unique and experimental updates shaped by feedback.

🔫 Weapon Skins, Loadouts & Long-Term Progression

All weapons support customizable skins and visual upgrades earned through gameplay. Experiment with different loadouts, refine your shooting style, and personalize your arsenal. The loot system feeds directly into shared progression, so every battle royale run matters.

From low poly, cubic, and minimalist designs to bold stylized finishes, weapons stay readable while feeling unique.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shipping & Handling is a cooperative multiplayer sandbox delivery game about moving through hostile environments while keeping a shared payload from damage until delivered!

You and your crew take on delivery runs across strange, dangerous spaces, dealing with terrain hazards, limited resources, and the chaos that comes from coordinating as a team. Stay alive and keep the delivery intact.

Core Gameplay

Players form a delivery crew and are tasked with delivering lost packages and transporting them to extraction points across large, hostile environments.

  • Scout routes and terrain

  • Collect cargo with varying sizes and weights

  • Transport cargo using silly tools, mounts, and physics-based interactions

  • Deal with hazards, enemies, and obstacles in clever and unique ways

  • Deliver successfully to earn rewards and unlock progression

  • Recover from failure when cargo is dropped, damaged, or lost

Each delivery can be completed multiple ways, but poor coordination or risky shortcuts can result in lost cargo and failed runs.

Online Multiplayer Co-op

  • Online cooperative multiplayer

  • Players coordinate movement, timing, and tool usage

  • Mistakes affect the entire team and create cascading problems

  • Solo play is possible, but the game is designed around emergent multiplayer situations

Traversal & Physics Systems

  • Physics-based balancing system

  • Vertical traversal including climbing, jumping, and sliding

  • Dynamic hazards such as unstable ground, environmental obstacles, hostile wildlife, and enemy robots attempting to steal deliveries

  • Cargo physically interacts with the world and players

Movement is intentionally physical and imperfect, creating unpredictable and often hilarious outcomes

Tools, Gear, and Mounts

  • Equip specialized tools to move cargo and navigate terrain

  • Deploy gadgets to create new paths and support your crew, including:

    • Ladders

    • Bridges

    • Grappling hooks

    • Healing hot tubs

    • Energy Drink Grenades 

    • And more!

  • Use mounts to assist with transport; mounts must be fed and cared for, and may need to be abandoned if situations worsen

Progression & Rewards

  • Earn currency from successful deliveries

  • Unlock new tools, upgrades, and traversal options

  • Access more dangerous delivery zones with higher rewards

  • Unlock Cosmetics

World & Tone

  • Stylized, low-poly, cartoony world

  • Multiple large delivery zones

  • A growing set of tools, cargo types, traversal challenges, and player customization

What Makes Shipping & Handling Unique

Shipping & Handling focuses on the act of co-op navigation through complex environments and active combat zones while keeping the payload safe from damage or theft.

The challenge comes from coordination, physical interaction, and route choice, creating unpredictable and memorable situations!

Shipping & Handling is being developed by a small independent team with experience working on large-scale multiplayer games, including developers who previously worked on Rec Room.

The game is currently in active development. Features, content, and scope may change as development continues.

One of the rare pure single-player retro 2D side-scrollers on Steam. Leave MMO pay-to-win gimmicks behind, and dive into stress-free loot-grinding fun!
Remember the thrill of grinding all afternoon for that perfect legendary gear? Tired of endless cash shops, mandatory dailies, and forced party play that killed your joy for side-scrolling adventures?
We’ve brought the soul of golden-age side-scrolling MMOs into a fully offline, single-player world. We recreated the iconic retro visuals you remember, and stripped out all pay-to-win bloat: no paid stat boosts, no mandatory quests, no risk of server shutdowns. This world is entirely yours.
Fight monsters born from Lower Realm projections, absorb pure EXP to unlock class potential and exclusive advancement paths. Relaxed Mode supports AFK auto-grinding — you set your own pace.
No forced rules, no grind traps, no pay-to-win. Just pure side-scrolling adventure, and satisfying loot-hunting fun.

  • Each profession features a unique advancement system, offering in-depth gameplay progression.

  • Easy Mode supports monster absorption, item absorption, and automatic skill casting, so you can grow your character easily even when away from keyboard.

store_data.about_the_game:
1.Description

Command massive planetary fleets in Star Command! An immersive real-time strategy epic. Utilize advanced physics engines to outsmart commanders worldwide in deep-space battlefronts. Conquer systems, upgrade fortresses, and turn the tide with "Shield Bursts." Featuring 1v1 Duels, 2v2Team Battle and 6-player Global Chaos.

2. About This Game

[Restoring Order to the Galaxy] The galaxy has slumbered in the "Great Silence" for three hundred years. As the last awakened Executor, you will carry the "Genesis Key" across eight lost sectors. This is not merely a journey of conquest, but a tactical game concerning the renaissance of civilization.

[Core Gameplay: Macro Tactics & Physical Micro-management]

  • Galactic Conquest: Every planet is your arsenal. Rationally allocate population growth and fleet deployment to build a solid logistics network.

  • Fleet Merging System: Units automatically cluster into powerful battle groups during hyperspace jumps, reducing chaos while greatly enhancing the visual impact of large-scale skirmishes.

  • Shield Burst: Once the planetary shield is fully charged, you can unleash a devastating energy pulse, evaporating all enemies entering the orbital ring.

  • Stellar Cataclysm: Capturing the central "Stellar Core" triggers a supernova. This is a "strategic nuke" capable of instantly wiping out all mobile units on the map—a gambit of high risk and high reward.

3. The Multiplayer Experience

The soul of this game lies in its minimalist multiplayer system.

Diverse Combat Modes:

  • Ranked Duel (1v1): Climb the MMR ladder in a pure contest of intellect and reflexes, aiming for the "God of War" rank.

  • Dark Forest Brawl (6-Player FFA): A survival game filled with chains of suspicion. You can choose to lie low and grow, or scavenge for profit while your opponents destroy each other.

  • Co-op Battle (2v2): Share intelligence with allies—one defends the fortress while the other flanks—to experience true interstellar collaboration.

Player Experience:

  • Zero-Wait Matchmaking: Smart matching protocols automatically recycle hosts based on player behavior, ensuring you connect to a valid signal within seconds.

  • Real-Time Telemetry HUD: A holographic UI designed specifically for combat, displaying real-time K/D ratios, force balance bars, and territory control, giving you complete mastery over the battlefield's flow.

  • Achievements & Glory: Every multiplayer victory earns you gold to unlock unique planet skins (such as "Fortress" or "Ancient Ruins") and ship appearances, making your fleet unique across the star map.

Every precise maneuver you make is writing a new history for the galaxy.

4. Visuals & Tech

Dynamic vignetting, bloom, and tone mapping create a cold, profound, and hardcore sci-fi atmosphere.

Procedural Music: A 128-bit synthesis engine dynamically switches themes based on battlefield tension, transitioning smoothly from serene exploration to intense crossfire.

store_data.about_the_game:
🎮 Peace and Prosperity

Forge your dynasty’s legacy in a solo-developed strategy epic set in a reimagined Pre-Qin China.

Begin your journey as the leader of a tiny village of 500 souls. Reclaim fertile farmland, build a thriving economy, forge a fearsome army, and conquer rival clans to rise from a local lord to the ruler of a million-strong vassal state.

Every choice defines your dynasty’s destiny. Will you fortify your realm with bountiful farms and stable trade, or race to build a war machine and strike first? Will you broker alliances to share wealth and power, or march to war and crush all who stand in your path to unification?

✨ Why Peace and Prosperity Stands Out

🎨 A Visual Masterpiece Inspired by Ancient Chinese Art

  • Rice Paper Background: Soft, warm tones that feel like holding a 2,000-year-old scroll in your hands.

  • Ink Black & Gold Accents: Bold contrast that blends classical elegance with modern readability.

  • Translucent UI Panels: Clean, unobtrusive design that keeps focus on the world, not the interface.

  • Ink-Wash Effects: Buttons and borders bloom with subtle, painterly smudges that feel alive.

🗺️ A Vast Hexagonal World of Discovery

  • Dynamic Terrain: Traverse plains, hills, mountains, forests, and wetlands — each with unique bonuses and pitfalls that shape your strategy.

  • Elevation & Slope: Climb hills for tactical advantage, or avoid steep mountains that slow your armies.

  • Rivers & Lakes: Use waterways as natural defenses or trade routes to fuel your growth.

  • Fog of War: Uncover hidden kingdoms, legendary rulers, and untold riches beyond your borders.

⚔️ Wage War Like an Ancient Warlord

Three-Stage Battle System

  • Charge Phase: Unleash cavalry charges to shatter enemy lines and break their armor.

  • Engagement Phase: Lock in infantry combat where training, morale, and terrain decide the tide.

  • Decisive Phase: Chase down fleeing foes once their morale collapses — or risk your own army routing if you falter.

  • Use historical tactics like pincer movements and flanking attacks: Support armies arriving from different directions trigger devastating tactical effects.

Morale & Supply: The Heart of War

  • Morale is everything — a broken army may be annihilated mid-battle.

  • Supply Line System: Keep your armies fed with logistics that mirror real history (expeditions cost massive manpower and resources!).

  • Camp Construction: Build outposts in the wilderness to secure supply lines… or raid enemy camps to starve their forces into submission.

🧠 Your Trusted AI Strategist

Never face a crisis alone. Your AI advisor:

  • Analyzes your kingdom’s strengths, weaknesses, and hidden threats.

  • Crafts actionable plans for economic growth, military campaigns, and diplomacy.

  • Alerts you to famine, rebellion, or incoming invasions before they spiral out of control.

🚀 More Features Coming Soon

New gameplay systems, art assets, and quality-of-life updates are in active development — and your feedback will shape them.

As a solo developer, this project is a labor of love. Join our community, share your thoughts, and help make Peace and Prosperity the ultimate Chinese strategy experience. Every suggestion from my loyal lords and officials brings this world closer to perfection!

store_data.about_the_game:
Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk is a first-person, single-player puzzle horror experience set in a fictional version of Edo-era Japan.

You play as Idate Chiyo, a junior investigator of the Tokugawa Shogunate’s Magical Arcane Division. Her first assignment leads to a secluded mansion hidden deep within the forests surrounding the coastal city of Gōtsu in Shimane Prefecture — and a once-prosperous household now abandoned.

Sightings of strange disturbances have begun to circulate throughout the countryside. The local villagers whisper of restless spirits. And the wealthy family who once lived there have vanished almost overnight.

Within the silent halls of the Hon'iden Mansion, Chiyo will encounter lingering apparitions, cursed artifacts, and fragments of a family history better left forgotten.

Escape Puzzle Horror

Scour the mansion for clues and solve escape room-inspired contraptions to unlock new areas and uncover the lingering truth hidden within this haunted place.

Paranormal Perception

As an investigator of the Magical Arcane Division, Chiyo possesses supernatural abilities which allow her to perceive and interact with forces beyond the ordinary world, amongst other tools needed to purge the curses hindering her progress.

House of Secrets

Piece together the fate of a powerful merchant family whose ambitions, and forbidden attachments have left behind a spiritual scar in their former estate.

Edo-era Atmosphere

The Hon'iden Mansion is both an immersive and terrifying experience, crafted with a heady mix of authenticity and terror in mind.
store_data.detailed_description:
Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk is a first-person, single-player puzzle horror experience set in a fictional version of Edo-era Japan.

You play as Idate Chiyo, a junior investigator of the Tokugawa Shogunate’s Magical Arcane Division. Her first assignment leads to a secluded mansion hidden deep within the forests surrounding the coastal city of Gōtsu in Shimane Prefecture — and a once-prosperous household now abandoned.

Sightings of strange disturbances have begun to circulate throughout the countryside. The local villagers whisper of restless spirits. And the wealthy family who once lived there have vanished almost overnight.

Within the silent halls of the Hon'iden Mansion, Chiyo will encounter lingering apparitions, cursed artifacts, and fragments of a family history better left forgotten.

Escape Puzzle Horror

Scour the mansion for clues and solve escape room-inspired contraptions to unlock new areas and uncover the lingering truth hidden within this haunted place.

Paranormal Perception

As an investigator of the Magical Arcane Division, Chiyo possesses supernatural abilities which allow her to perceive and interact with forces beyond the ordinary world, amongst other tools needed to purge the curses hindering her progress.

House of Secrets

Piece together the fate of a powerful merchant family whose ambitions, and forbidden attachments have left behind a spiritual scar in their former estate.

Edo-era Atmosphere

The Hon'iden Mansion is both an immersive and terrifying experience, crafted with a heady mix of authenticity and terror in mind.
store_data.short_description: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk is a first-person, single-player, escape room puzzle horror game set in a fictional Edo Japan. Assume the role of Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator, tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark and horrifying secret.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Let's all protect the sheet music together at the Hatcho Detective Agency!"

<STORY>

You, the player, are hired as a part-time assistant to music detective Hatcho Shirabe.

In a peaceful town where crime never seems to occur, Shirabe and his team work as detectives, doing a jack-of-all-trades kind of job. Recently, they've received a disturbing email.

A phantom thief calling himself Canon the Phantom Thief is coming to steal an ancient sheet music with 1,000 years of history stored at the Music Culture Museum.

You, along with Shirabe, the director, and your assistant, Ellen, head to the museum to protect the sheet music.

<ABOUT>

"Shirabe Hatcho and the Ancient Score" is a music mystery ADV game where you solve puzzles using sound as a clue.

As an assistant to the detective Shirabe Hatcho, you unravel the music-related mysteries set by the phantom thief Canon, also known as the Phantom Thief.

This game features numerous "ear-solving" gimmicks, including audio, sheet music, and instrument performances.

Through exploration and conversation, you'll uncover the museum's hidden secrets and the thief's motives.

<FEATURES>

🎵 Original puzzles solved by distinguishing sounds

📜 Puzzle elements using sheet music and musical notation

🕵️ A story-driven ADV game driven by exploration and deduction

💡 Hint function included, so even those with poor pitch can rest assured

🌸 A mystery? A bright and light-hearted worldview

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Team Principal: A Racing Manager. Initially a passion project, this game has become much more for me. It is a completely customizable grand prix/motorsport manager game, with a simplistic top down 2d race view. Most of the game is in the in-depth management aspect. Some key features include:

- An ever-changing grid: Teams & engines can leave, go bankrupt, join, rebrand, get bought out, fluctuate season to season. No two seasons will ever be the same, with a virtually limitless grid size.
- Simplistic, yet in-depth race simulation complete with customizable temperature, weather, dirty air, tire wear, fuel consumption, safety cars, mechanical wear, and realistic results, with both simulated and non-simulated options available.

- In-Depth finance system with stock, ownership, and ability to purchase stakes in rivals.

- Completely in-depth academy pipe-line system with ability to pay to assign your rookie drivers in junior series teams, have them test for you, learn the ropes in rival junior teams you own, and eventually promote them to your team.

- In-depth regulatory system that can change the environment of the game season to season.

- In-depth negotiation system for tyres, parts, sponsorship, works engines, customer engines, and drivers. 

- Ability to build and sell your own engines through an engine plant, or partner with an existing engine supplier.

- Extremely intelligent AI who are truly difficult to beat.

- Fully fleshed out car attributes, driver attributes, staff attributes, headquarters, etc.

- In-depth chassis, aero, engine, and tyre development.

This game aims to be a simplistic, yet fully customizable racing management sandbox experience for racing in every era, with almost every aspect of the game able to be edited and changed. Team names, performance, dirty air, tire model, points model, anything one can think of can be edited to your liking.

This game is in active development & will receive extremely frequently updates. Please join the game's discord server, wherein I will share future plans, update timelines, provide bug support, as well as the track editor. This game is extremely mod friendly, and an open canvas for any situations one wishes to develop.

store_data.about_the_game:
ZeliFactory is a falling-block puzzle × 2D action game where you simultaneously control the blocks falling from above and a freely moving Zeli on the screen, clearing lines to earn high scores.

Simply stacking blocks isn’t enough to complete a line.
Move, push, and sometimes break them with Zeli—
your action skills and puzzle-solving judgment will both be put to the test.

Game Modes

  • Endless Mode

In Endless Mode, you advance through rounds by earning points until you produce the required number of Zeli for each round.

As you progress, the difficulty steadily increases, demanding sharper decision-making and precise control. See how far you can go and challenge your limits.

  • Score Attack

Score Attack is a time-limited mode where the goal is to earn as many points as possible before time runs out.

Quick thinking and efficient line clears are essential, making it perfect for intense, high-score-focused play sessions.

store_data.about_the_game:
An “Exit 8”-like game.

The setting is a hotel-style mansion.

You are invited by a girl you like, but trials await you when you arrive.

Can you reach your beloved as quickly as possible?

—

【About the Game】

1.Memorize the structure of the correct room (the sample room). Once memorized, head to the elevator at the front.

2.If you notice an anomaly, go to the elevator at the back. If there is no anomaly, go to the elevator at the front.

3.Repeat steps 1 and 2. This time, there are multiple correct rooms, so be sure to memorize the correct layout each time you are in step 1.

※ If you are confused and cannot tell whether the room is a sample room or an anomaly room, you can check by whether the option to use the back elevator appears. In the sample room, only the front elevator can be used.

—

【Controls】

・Movement
Arrow keys or WASD

・Camera
Mouse drag (up, down, left, right)

・Pause
P key

・Cursor control during pause
Mouse drag (up, down, left, right)

※ On the menu screen, you can move the selection with the up/down keys and confirm with left click.

—

※ About video streaming
Live streaming and video uploads are allowed.
Please include the game title and URL.

store_data.about_the_game:
Between is a story-driven visual novel focused on relationships, choices, and emotional moments set in a calm coastal town.

You arrive at Valenport looking for a change of pace, but soon find yourself drawn into the lives of several women you meet along the way. Conversations, shared moments, and personal decisions gradually shape how these relationships develop—and how the story concludes.

The narrative unfolds through dialogue-driven scenes and illustrated story moments that highlight key points in each route. Your choices influence how close you grow to each character and determine which ending you reach.

The experience is designed to be relaxed and reflective, placing emphasis on atmosphere, pacing, and character interaction rather than fast gameplay.

Features

  • Story-driven visual novel experience

  • Player choices that affect character routes and endings

  • Multiple relationship paths

  • Illustrated CG scenes tied to story progression

  • Calm coastal setting with ambient background music

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn your desktop into a living, dancing stage.

HearHen is a companion-style desktop game where cute characters react to the sounds you play on your PC. Whether it’s music, videos, game audio, or even your own instrument through a mic or audio interface, they will listen, feel the rhythm, and move with the mood in real time.

Soft music makes them gently sway. Energetic beats make them burst into joyful dance. Summon a cute kitty or puppy, a screaming chicken, a capybara, a ninja, or even the Mona Lisa directly onto your desktop. Drag them around, let them chat with you, and watch them interact inside freely switchable scenes such as caves, deserts, Dutch windmills, or museums. Your everyday screen becomes a tiny animated world that lives alongside your work and music.

Each character has unique animations, voices, and sounds. Trigger their sounds manually or play them like a mini soundboard to remix your own audio and create playful moments on the fly.

Free to start: a selection of characters and scenes is available at no cost. Expand your collection with special characters and themed environments to build your own personalized, music-driven desktop companion space.

Open your favourite music, drop them onto your screen, and just let them dance with you!

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

The Last Shot: Underworld casts players in the role of an aging scientist who, by a sinister twist of fate, finds himself deep in the dungeons of Metropolis—a place inhabited by victims of monstrous experiments, rogue robots, and other unfortunate souls cast down to the depths. To repay his debt to life and return home, you must survive this hell using your intellect and whatever comes to hand.

Master an underworld filled with false hopes. Venture through diverse and mysterious biomes to build a community of outcast survivors, unravel the dark secrets of this place, and pull off the Great Escape.

Features

  • Style: Immerse yourself in a visual aesthetic inspired by classic animated films, infused with a hearty dose of retrofuturism.

  • Gameplay: Craft ingenious mechanisms, build automated farms, battle enemies, gather resources, complete quests, and develop your character to survive and escape.

  • Key Feature: A vast, endless array of robots, biomechanisms, and machinery to understand, assemble, or defeat.

*Your intellect is your greatest weapon. Your goal is the light above.

But there’s more!

Beyond its gripping story, The Last Shot: Underworld is a spin-off of the cult platformer adventure where you play as the father of the original game’s protagonist, with events unfolding in parallel! It’s a unique adventure blending Idle and IdleRPG elements in a dieselpunk universe of massive guns and gears.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

A climb for glory. A fall for the soul.
Glow Down is a hardcore precision platformer about falling, perseverance, and the quiet weight of expectation. You are a princess, alone, climbing an unforgiving tower to meet a hero who waits at the summit.
Or so you’ve been told.

The Cost of Failure

Inspired by the mechanical tension of Jump King, every movement in Glow Down is a calculated risk.

Master the Jump
Every leap is fully charged and must be carefully aimed. There are no mid-air corrections, and hesitation is often punished.

No Safety Net
There are no generous checkpoints. A single mistake can send you tumbling back down, costing minutes... or hours of hard-earned progress.

The Beauty System
Failure leaves a mark. With every fall, you lose not only height, but beauty. Your appearance reflects the toll of the climb, creating constant pressure to remain presentable, capable… worthy.

A World in the Clouds

The tower is not empty.

Along your ascent, you will encounter other souls trapped within the vertical labyrinth:

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive until 6:00 AM in a cooperative asymmetric horror game built around communication, pressure, and constant decision-making. One player takes the role of a Security Guard, monitoring camera feeds and controlling doors, lights, and building systems, while the rest of the team moves through the facility completing dangerous, noise-filled tasks in real time.

Coordinate under stress as power drains, systems malfunction, and information becomes unreliable. Radios distort, cameras glitch, doors jam, and monsters adapt to how you play, reacting to sound, movement, and hesitation. Every action has consequences, and a single mistake can put the entire team at risk.

Each night escalates with more tasks, higher pressure, and less room for error. Success depends on trust, clear callouts, and knowing when not to act.

Finish the work, survive the shift, and make it to 6:00 AM. Then do it all again.

You are the "Guy in the Chair." Safely sealed in the security room, you operate the Sentinel-OS v3.1 terminal to manipulate the facility’s infrastructure and lead the operatives.

  • Command the Grid: Manage a failing power generator. Every door you lock and camera you check drains energy.

  • Surveillance: Monitor the squad via grainy CCTV feeds and bio-metric scanners. You see what they can't.

  • Guide the Team: Use the facility map to route your friends around procedural threats.

  • Distract the Monster: Play sound lures, manipulate sprinkler systems, or anything else in your power to keep the monster away from your team.

You are the worker. You and your team must complete tasks around the facility while staying clear of the monsters that lurk within. Complete all tasks before 6AM to collect your payout

  • Proximity Chat: Communication is your lifeline. If you stray too far, you die alone.

  • Manual Tasks: Physical interaction is required. Fix wiring, carry heavy crates, and hack keypads while watching your back.

  • Limited Visibility: Your knowledge is limited. Trust the Guard to tell you what lies ahead in the dark and where to go next.

Greed is dangerous, but gets rewarded. Every night ends with a choice.

  • The Risk Loop: Survive the night to earn cash. Choose to cash out to bank your earnings, or extend contract to come back for another night with increased pressure, more aggressive enemies, but most importantly, a much higher salary.

  • Permadeath Economy: If the squad wipes, the contract is terminated and no payout will be granted.

  • Procedural Escalation: No two shifts are the same. Objective locations and monster spawns are randomized every night.

store_data.about_the_game:
OUT OF TIME: A DIGITAL SANCTUARY
IMPORTANT: This is a digital art installation, not a classic game.

CONCEPT AND PURPOSE (KATHARSIS)

Out of Time is an original meditation and art-therapeutic platform. It is designed to immerse the user in a state of “flow”, where the boundaries between time and space blur. This is not a space for sleep preparation ー it is a place for intense katharsis, emotional purification, and confrontation with one’s own process of discovery.

In a world dominated by superficial stimulation, this project offers a safe haven for the mind, based on the foundations of aesthetics and primal art therapy. Inspired by the 17th-century philosophy of Robert Fludd, this installation offers an exploration of the emerging realm of Entity: from dense, dark matter (hyle), through the abyss (abyssus) and chaos, to the ethereal function of fog (caligo).

EXPERIENCE AND EXPLORATION

Out of Time is a radical art installation, not a traditional game. I deliberately abandon typical mechanics, menus, and goals to enable a full, physical presence. Enter this world if you are seeking an experience, rather than traditional gameplay.

Absolute Freedom: Here, time does not exist. The experience is unlimited ー  You can stay for 15 minutes or several hours, depending on your needs. No goals are imposed. Your task is to simply BE and allow the free flow of thoughts. 

UNIVERSAL LANGUAGE 

A wordless narrative built through light, geometry, and your own movement – ​​accessible to anyone, regardless of language.

DIALOGUE WITH SPACE

Using motion controllers, you navigate through invisible sound paths. Follow your ears. Invisible sound tunnels are placed throughout the environment to guide you through the experience.

DIGITAL SOLACE

An environment designed to facilitate cognitive development and entering a state of "flow", conducive to stress reduction.

ARTISTIC LEGACY & EVOLUTION

Rooted in deep research into new media art, Out of Time originated as a core diploma at the Academy of Fine Arts in Katowice. Following its premiere at prestigious exhibitions, including the 10th Triennial of Polish Graphic Art, the project has been fully reimagined in Unreal Engine 5.

This evolution from the original concept to the current high-fidelity vision enables a profound multisensory experience—a space where historical philosophical inquiry meets the frontier of cutting-edge VR technology.

TECHNICAL INFORMATION

Personal experience as a natural extension of the body, an uninterrupted meditative process.

Control: Motion controllers required.

Sound: Headphones required.

Comfort: Comfortable VR – no sudden movements; support for standing, sitting and lying positions.

About the Game

This is a world filled with random elements. Obtain random equipment and skills through card draws, use maps to enter random stages (which may lead to reward stages with no combat required). Continuously acquire stronger items to challenge more difficult stages and bosses.

About Items

Items are divided into equipment and skills, with colors ranging from low to high: white, blue, purple, orange, red, and silver, totaling nearly 200 types. Except for silver items, which can only be obtained from red card packs, items of other colors can be acquired from corresponding colored card packs and stages.

About Card Draws

There are five types of card packs, priced from low to high: white, blue, purple, orange, and red. Each pack contains five random cards, which may include maps, items, or currency. Red card packs can only be obtained from orange card packs and cannot be purchased.

About Stages

By consuming maps obtained from card packs, enter random stages corresponding to the map's color. There is a chance to enter reward stages with no combat required. Chests will randomly appear in stages.

About Monsters

As the color level increases, monster strength and the amount of currency dropped will progressively rise. Bosses drop items of the corresponding color. Elite bosses are significantly enhanced and have a chance to drop corresponding boss skills.

About Combat

There are two attack methods: swinging a sword and shooting arrows. Additionally, powerful abilities can be gained through equipped skills.

store_data.about_the_game:
LarsGadiel is the prequel to Xenon Valkyrie, a game originally created for the Nintendo 8-bit console that was never released (so far). Now it finally arrives on PC with this Pixel Perfect Port.

This version includes several changes that enhance the experience and make better use of the screen to display more information.

LarsGadiel is a classic Metroidvania, featuring an original retro map and level design, amazing 8-bit music, and graphics and colors faithful to the Nintendo NES.

Features

  • Authentic old-school Metroidvania experience.

  • New exploration system with HUD and enhanced map for modern displays.

  • Many secrets, including some exclusive to this port.

  • Exclusive Teleport System.

  • Multiple visual modes, such as Retro CRT.

  • Added RPG elements like weapon leveling.

  • Includes mechanics from modern Metroidvania titles.

  • Authentic chiptune soundtrack, using the original NES 8-bit sound chip.

  • Challenging, with labyrinthine maps.

  • And much more!

Controls

Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS4, and PS5 controllers work perfectly.

Depending on OS and version, details may vary.

Steam Deck

Fully compatible with Steam Deck, featuring an exclusive mode for this incredible system.

store_data.about_the_game:
DATE TEACHER: LOVE, LIES & ALGORITHMS

Welcome to a dating experience that blurs the line between reality and simulation. In a world where emotions are rendered and truth is a matter of perspective, you are the observer.

## 💔 TRUST IS FRAGILE In DATE TEACHER, your choices aren't just A or B. You can choose to lie. But be careful: Your partners are observant. They track your inconsistencies. If you claim to be at home but later mention a party, they will catch you.

  • Micro-Expressions: Watch their reactions closely. A frown or a raised eyebrow might mean they doubt your story.

  • Confrontation: If their suspicion peaks, they won't just leave—they will interrogate you.

  • Harsh Reality: Fail to maintain your cover, and receive a brutal evaluation of your character at the end of the date.

KEY FEATURES:

  • 🎥 Massive Cinematic Library: Experience a colossal narrative consisting of 1733 hyper-realistic 3D scenes rendered in stunning FULL-HD.

  • 🎭 17 Unique Characters: Meet a cast of complex individuals brought to life with detailed facial animations. From a Quantum Physicist questioning reality to a French Literature Professor obsessed with subtext.

  • 🤥 Lie Detection Mechanics: Every character has a secret. Analyze their micro-expressions and dialogue to distinguish between an honest confession and a manipulative lie.

  • 🧠 Psychological Depth: This is not just about flirting. Engage in deep philosophical debates about ethics, simulation theory, and the nature of existence.

  • ⚠️ DEVELOPER NOTE & LOCALIZATION DISCLAIMER:

    "Hi, I'm Onur. I am the solo developer behind Date Teacher. Bringing 17 characters and 1733 scenes to life has been a passionate journey of storytelling and coding.

    A Note on Languages: To make this story accessible to the whole world, I have localized the game into 8 languages (English, German, Spanish, Russian, French, Japanese, Chinese, Turkish). Since I am an indie developer, I utilized Poedit and AI-assisted translation tools to achieve this massive scale. While I strived for accuracy, there may be minor nuances that differ from a native speaker's touch. I hope these stories touch your heart regardless of the language you speak. Thank you for your support!"

store_data.about_the_game:
Racing Balls is a fast-paced, top-down arcade racer about rhythm, clean lines and split-second decisions. Drift through tight lanes, time your boosts and survive a gauntlet of spinning paddles, bumpers, flippers, and speed traps. Every lap rewards consistency and control, whether you are battling the AI in a full championship or chasing a perfect time-trial run.

Key features:

  • 24 official tracks to unlock, with progression and Hall of Fame

  • Physics-based handling with drift, boost and shield tactics

  • Dynamic hazards and trackside obstacles that change race rhythm

  • Global standings, XP, and track records for verified official runs

  • Track editor + Explorer for building, sharing and racing custom circuits

PICK YOUR MODE

Championship

Win races to unlock the next official track in order. For each track you have to qualify in Q2 (top 15 on 20 drivers) and Q1 (top 10 on 15 drivers) races and win the final Race to go to next in order. Clear all tracks to enter the Hall of Fame.

Time trial

Solo laps against the clock. Chase track records on official or custom circuits (via the track explorer).

Single race

Jump into one official track you already unlocked. No qualifying rounds and no progression unlocks.

Spectate

Pick a driver, watch the race unfold, and swap between leader and driver cameras.

RACE FLOW & TRACK RULES

  • Laps: A track consists of between three and five laps.

  • Obstacles: rotating paddles, triangles, bumpers, squares, tilt bars, spinners, moving platforms.

  • Shapes: triangles, half-circles, trapezoids for trackside terrain and runoffs.

  • Walls & curbs: keep you in-bounds and slow wall riding.

  • Pit stops: restart your vehicle with restored health by holding and relaunching back onto the track.

  • PTP zones: push-to-pass bands for acceleration bursts.

The tracks are designed to reward clean lines and good timing. Every run is about reading the rhythm in order to achieve the perfect lap time.

OBSTACLES & SHAPES

Obstacles are the static and moving threats that change race rhythm, while shapes are the building blocks that define lanes, edges, and shortcuts.

PROGRESS, RECORDS AND COMMUNITY

Official races and time trials feed the global leaderboards, XP, and records. Your Box keeps a local log of recent races.

  • Global standings: hall of fame and track records are divided by world, continent and countries. teams and drivers rise as verified official results stream in.

  • Box: quick access to recent races, positions, and lap summaries.

  • XP: earned on verified official runs (wins, records, and championships).

  • Track records: best times per track, updated when a run beats the current time.

  • Hall of Fame: clear all official tracks in order to claim a spot.

TRACK EDITOR & EXPLORER

Build your own circuits, test them instantly and share them with the community. The Explorer is where you can find tracks created by the community. Set a track record on one of their tracks!

  • Track editor: draw the layout, place obstacles, tune difficulty, make your track public.

  • Explorer: browse published tracks and jump straight into a race against AI or set a track record with a time trial.

Deadly Dimensions is a First-Person Rogue-Lite Survival-Horror Game.

Traverse a multitude of unknown Dimensions of Earth and scavenge all of the Data and Info you can possibly find whilst surviving the lingering threats and Anomalies that are looking for you.

Across your multiple Dimensional Expeditions, you will meet a various number of Dimensional Anomalies. Beings that got corrupted and gone feral from the liminal nature of these endlessly repeating rooms and corridors. Don't linger too long in a room, who knows what kind of threats your unsuspecting mind would come across.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES:

  • Endless Replayability: Every run is randomly generated, nothing stays the same. With over 150+ individual hand-crafted rooms for the Game to randomly choose from.

  • Plenty of Dimensions to Discover: Each time you fully complete a Dimension, a new one will be discovered in the Map. Each Dimension has its very own completely new biomes, rooms, and sub-rooms!

  • Meta-Progression and Upgrades: The better you play, the better you are rewarded with the company's currency: Data Cells! These Data Cells can be used to unlock and upgrade all sorts of things to help you further. From equipment, to perks, and more.

  • Original Soundtrack: 15+ Tracks to unpack for your ears to enjoy.

  • Hard Mode: After you finish a Dimension in Normal Mode for the first time, you can unlock for this same Dimension a completely customizable Hard Mode that lets you choose how difficult you want your Run to be. The more difficult you make it, the more handsomely rewarded by the company you will be!

  • 30+ Achievements to Collect: Achievements are the back-bone of Deadly Dimensions. Many will offer unique challenges that will make you play the Game differently, and some will make you discover some secrets.. and some will truly make you bite some dust.

  • And SO much more...

WARNING: Deadly Dimensions contains heavy flashing lights, jump-scares, loud noises, blood, horrifying atmosphere and much more. You have been warned.

And most importantly, H A V E  F U N !

(Deadly Dimensions is a Game made by a very small team of two indie developers!)

store_data.about_the_game:
On the open sea, the line between mission and desire disappears.


ICE Melts 2: Caribbean Cruise is an Adult Romance Visual Novel where federal agent Jack boards the luxury liner Caribbean Queen undercover—hunting a smuggling pipeline hidden behind champagne smiles and postcard sunsets.

As the ship cuts through paradise, Jack closes in on three women tied to the investigation: the magnetic Activity Director who knows every secret below deck, the untouchable VIP whose identity doesn't add up, and the shy steward whose fear of authority runs deeper than nerves.

One choice at a glittering cocktail party sets your route—and forces Jack to decide what he's willing to sacrifice when attraction turns the case into something dangerously personal.

Meet the Cast

Amara — Silent Elegance


A VIP passenger wrapped in wealth and distance, Amara watches the ship like she doesn't belong to it—and maybe doesn't. Her poise is immaculate, her solitude deliberate, and her paperwork just a little too perfect. With Amara, romance becomes a high-stakes negotiation between control, safety, and the kind of trust money can't buy.

Dominique — Vibrant Energy


The Caribbean Queen's Activity Director radiates command, rhythm, and a party-ready smile that never seems to falter—until the doors close. Dominique challenges Jack's "tourist" act with playful heat and fearless honesty, pulling him into a connection that's as competitive as it is electric.

Chantelle — Hidden Grace


A young cabin steward who keeps her head down and her voice soft, Chantelle moves through the ship like she's trying not to be seen—especially by authority. When Jack chooses comfort over interrogation, she reveals a vulnerability that turns his mission into something intensely personal.

Key Features

  • Single-choice branching romance: Your decision during The Captain's Cocktail locks in one focused route with its own escalating stakes and ending.
  • Undercover tension in a luxury setting: Sun decks, VIP suites, crew corridors, and midnight staff areas—where "vacation" is just another disguise.
  • Forbidden Waters theme: Enforce the law… or fall for someone who may be the target, the key witness, or the collateral damage.
  • Illusion of Paradise atmosphere: Glittering parties and ocean views contrasted with exhaustion, isolation, and the unseen pressures of life at sea.
  • Three distinct love interests, three different fantasies: High-energy rivals-to-lovers, cool "first class" intrigue, and tender protector romance.

Content Advisory

This is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences (18+). It contains sexual content and themes of power, coercion, exploitation, and morally complex choices.

store_data.about_the_game:
Meet Project Alex — Your Intelligent Desktop Companion

Project Alex is an experimental AI assistant that lives on your desktop, not in a browser tab. Unlike Siri or ChatGPT, Alex runs entirely locally on your machine. She sees your cursor, sits on your active windows, and talks with you via voice in real-time.

✨ Key Features

  • Full Voice Control: Just speak naturally. Just say "Alex". No wake words required (uses VAD).

  • Interruptible: You can cut her off mid-sentence to change the topic, just like a real conversation.

  • 100% Private & Offline: Powered by local Whisper (STT), Llama (LLM), and Kokoro (TTS). No audio or data ever leaves your PC.

  • Desktop Presence: She follows your cursor, reacts to your actions, and sits on your active windows.

⚠️ Early Access Notice

This is an Alpha Build.

  • You may encounter bugs with window transparency or overlapping.

  • The settings menu is currently a work in progress.

  • Please report any crashes or issues in the Community Hub!

💻 System Requirements

Since the AI runs locally on your hardware, a dedicated GPU is highly recommended.

  • OS: Windows 10/11

  • GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or better recommended.

  • RAM: 8GB+ minimum (16GB recommended).

  • Microphone: Required.

🛠️ Tech Stack

Built with Godot 4. Uses Silero VAD, Whisper, Llama, and Kokoro TTS.

Color Theory is a fully ray-traced arcade game featuring two game modes. The first is an arena shooter in which you can only destroy enemies by shooting their reflections. The second is a puzzle game in which you look for matching marbles and point out impostors.

Game 1

  • FPS controls (right-click to zoom, shift to run, space to jump, esc to pause)

  • Avoid contact with enemy spheres or the game ends

  • Enemies can only be destroyed by shooting their reflections through the correct mirror

Game 2

  • Point-and-click item hunt

  • Follow instructions to either find identical marbles, or point out impostors

  • Wrong guesses result in a time penalty

  • Use arrow keys to spin the board, or space to pause rotation

Trailer Music:

store_data.about_the_game:
Farming has never been this bloody.

Were you hoping for a peaceful retirement, growing tomatoes to relax? You're in the wrong game.

In AGGRO, that hoe in your hand isn't just for tilling the soil—it's for gutting the creatures coming to devour you. Customers are impatient, crops are rotting, and you have only 8 minutes to survive.

No breathing room. No stopping. Just Chaos, Harvest, and Rage.

This isn't your grandma's farm. You must keep one eye on the crops and the other on the approaching horde.

  • Hybrid Gameplay: The forbidden love child of a Farming Sim and a Hack & Slash. Harvest crops, fill the register, and use the cash to upgrade your arsenal.

  • Reflex Driven: Master the art of animation canceling. Harvest a turnip, slash a beast, repeat. Turn the field into a bloodbath.

  • Chaotic Economy: Customers don't wait. Miss an order or deliver late, and you lose more than just money—you lose your head.

Time is your worst enemy. Every run lasts only 8 minutes.

  • Pure Adrenaline: There is no luxury of playing slow. Every second, enemies get stronger, and waves get denser.

  • Strategic Decisions: Do you harvest for cash or run for your life? Greed is the fastest way to die in AGGRO.

  • Endless Replayability: Did you die? Good. Learn from your mistakes, change your strategy, and strike back harder.

store_data.about_the_game:
You hadn’t heard from your grandparents in weeks.

What was meant to be a simple visit turns into something far more unsettling as you arrive at their remote home, surrounded by forest and silence. The house is empty — but it doesn’t feel abandoned.

Explore the environment, search for clues, and piece together what happened through careful observation and investigation. As you move from room to room, familiar spaces begin to feel increasingly wrong, revealing details that suggest someone — or something — was never truly gone.

This is a slow-burning psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, discovery, and tension built over time.


KEY FEATURES

• Atmospheric Exploration

Move through a dense forest and a seemingly ordinary house where subtle details, sound design, and lighting create constant unease.

• Psychological Horror

A slow-burn horror experience that builds tension through pacing, implication, and environmental changes, drawing players deeper into an unsettling atmosphere.

• Environmental Storytelling

Notes, objects, and altered spaces tell a story without exposition. The truth reveals itself only to those who pay attention.

• Puzzle-Based Progression

Solve a variety of puzzles naturally integrated into the environment. Each challenge feels grounded in the setting and serves to deepen immersion while moving the story forward.

GAMEPLAY

  • First-person exploration

  • Investigation and clue discovery

  • Multiple environmental and logic-based puzzles

  • Story-driven progression

  • Multiple endings

store_data.about_the_game:
Romanian folk horror about guild, money, and sin.

Told like a fireside tale and experienced as a dark folk story, this game pulls you into a rural Romanian village in the early 2000s, where you experience inspirations drawn from classic Romanian literature and folklore.

The story follows Ion, a simple farmer obsessed with Vasile, the wealthy owner of Hanul Gospodarului.

Consumed by his hunger for money, Ion’s mind begins to fracture, until greed drives him to commit an unforgivable act.

Key Features

  • Psychological narrative horror – fear born from silence, guilt, and implication

  • Slow exploration & symbolic puzzles – wells, churches, icons, and objects that “remember.”

  • Authentic folk atmosphere – inspired by Eastern European folklore and rural morality

  • Cinematic experience – no intrusive HUD, no cheap jumpscares

Atmosphere & Visual Style

  • Dirty yellow lighting, like old bulbs and candlelight

  • Shadows that ooze and cling to walls

  • Living objects: the bell breathes, wax flows upward, the earth beats like a heart

  • Folk narration and bitter humor, spoken as if from another age

store_data.about_the_game:
Become #1 while being a #2!

FighTurd is a quirky action platformer about an unexpected hero on an unforgettable journey.

When disaster strikes and the toilet is clogged, a small but determined turd sets out to find his missing friends. What begins as a simple search quickly turns into an adventurous trek through a house, streets and strange underground worlds filled with danger, mystery, and heart.

Blending tight platforming with fast, satisfying combat, FighTurd challenges players to master movement, timing, and enemy patterns. Each area introduces new enemies, environmental hazards, and mechanics that keep the gameplay feeling fresh and rewarding from start to finish.

Along the way, you’ll face a lineup of creative boss battles, each with their own personality and unique mechanics. These encounters push your skills to the limit while delivering memorable moments that stick with you long after the fight is over.

Beneath its silly premise, FighTurd is a lighthearted adventure about friendship, perseverance, and pushing forward—even when the odds (and the environment) aren’t exactly ideal.

Features

  • Smooth, responsive action-platformer gameplay

  • Handcrafted themed levels with secrets to discover

  • Creative boss fights with unique mechanics

  • A charmingly weird cast of enemies and characters

  • A fun, humorous tone with genuine challenge

Whether you’re here for the platforming, the enemies, or the laughs, FighTurd offers a surprisingly polished and joyful indie experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
6-7 In-A-Row is a fast, competitive strategy board game for 2–4 players that mixes the instant clarity of Tic-Tac-Toe with the “one more round” tension of Connect-4 style games—without gravity.

Place your token anywhere on the board. No dropping, no sliding, no excuses. Build lines, block threats, set traps, and try to be the first to connect at least 6 in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal).

And yes… winning with 6 is a win... technically.
The game will acknowledge it accordingly.

Key Features:

  • Win condition with attitude: Connect 6+ in a row to win. The longer your line, the better the bragging rights (and the less judgment you’ll receive).

  • 2–4 players: Play head-to-head or bring the chaos with 3–4 colors.

  • Local + Online (Friends): Pass-and-play locally or challenge friends online in a private lobby. (Matchmaking may come later.)

  • Bots with 3 difficulties: Practice against Easy / Medium / Hard AI—good luck blaming lag.

  • 3D with a 2D feel: A clean tabletop presentation built for readability, with zoom + slight pan + reset camera controls.

  • Humor system: Randomized humorous win/lose/tie phrases, including custom lines depending on whether you won with 6, 7, or more.

  • Online per-turn timers (optional): Keep matches moving when things get serious.

Simple rules. Real strategy. Friendly roasting.

  • 3D with a 2D feel: A clean tabletop presentation built for readability, with zoom + slight pan + reset camera controls.

  • Humor system: Randomized humorous win/lose/tie phrases, including custom lines depending on whether you won with 6, 7, or more.

  • Online per-turn timers (optional): Keep matches moving when things get serious.

Simple rules. Real strategy. Friendly roasting.
store_data.short_description: A modern tabletop-style strategy game for 2–4 players. Local or online with friends, bots from Easy to Hard, and hilarious win/lose lines based on how hard you actually won. Place tokens anywhere on the board and line up 6+ in a row to win. Winning with 6 counts… technically.

store_data.about_the_game:
• Inception: SCP: Studies started as a side project in late 2021 to learn unreal as I worked with Aethon after my short time working on SCP:Unity as a minor developer. I started with zero knowledge in the engine, and only 3-D knowledge. However I enjoyed learning visual scripting, sound design, UI and everything else that comes with it so I decided to start working on SCP Studies as my main project.

  • Gameplay: SCP: Studies is a first person game where you interact with SCP's, these interactions can vary from puzzles to upgrades, showcases, and yes of course horror. An evacuation has just been under way, leaving most of the systems still running but they will fail over time. This includes containment chambers, where you can experience SCPs in an interactive way and change the ill-fated facility for the better or don’t and let everything fail in a classic total containment breach. Try to study as many SCPs as you can find and get out of the facility with your mind intact.

Setting: You play as a Level 1 Researcher, as far as the Foundation knows, in the early 90’s. Site-191 is underground in the Midwest USA as a fake Seed Vault. Use some retro tech and alternative versions of SCPs to get what you really came for.

Save the Kingdom

Awaken as a fallen hero from a forgotten age, resurrected in a kingdom overwhelmed by technology. Magic has faded, and humanity is not far behind. Each time you fall, you will rise again—rebuilt with more technology and less of who you once were.

Real-Time Combat

Combat in Cyberknight: Awakening blends fast-paced action with tactical decision-making. Select cartridges from your hand to shape your abilities, then navigate the grid in real time—dodging enemy attacks while waiting for your moment to strike.

Build Your Deck

Every cartridge represents an attack, spell, or upgrade. With each awakening, discover new cartridges and powerful artifacts that transform your gameplay. Create synergistic decks tailored to your playstyle—whether you prefer agile swordplay, ranged zoning attacks, or combo-driven abilities.

Create Your Destiny

No two journeys are the same. Navigate branching paths and locations to uncover secrets about your new world. Each resurrection presents unique challenges and difficult choices that shape your fate, identity, and the future of the kingdom.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Name: Mo Wu Tian Gong

Step into the vast, ancient Eastern world of *Mo Wu Tian Gong*, an open-world action-survival game. Experience a unique adventure that blends hardcore combat, deep crafting, and mystical Taoist cultivation.

**Core Gameplay:**

* **Open World Exploration:** Freely explore a majestic, painterly landscape of misty mountains, bamboo forests, and crumbling ruins, each filled with secrets, resources, and danger.

* **Survival & Building:** Gather resources, hunt, and endure the elements. Establish your sanctuary, evolving it from a simple shelter into a fortified estate with workshops and alchemy labs.

* **Souls-like Combat:** Master a precise, skill-based combat system. Wield traditional weapons and execute fluid martial arts techniques to overcome challenging enemies and epic bosses.

* **Taoist Spell Crafting:** Unlock the secrets of the Five Elements. Harness elemental magic to unleash devastating spells in combat or to enchant your weapons and fortify your constructions.

**Key Features:**

* **Unique "Ink & Ascent" Aesthetic:** Immerse yourself in a world inspired by ink-wash painting and Taoist philosophy.

* **Solo & Multiplayer:** Journey alone as a solitary warrior or unite with friends to build settlements and conquer challenges together in online co-op.

* **Deep Systems Synergy:** Seamlessly blend survival, building, combat, and magic. Create enchanted gear and empower your base through alchemy and elemental fusion.

Forge your own path in *Mo Wu Tian Gong*—will you be a master survivor, an unparalleled martial artist, or an enlightened mystic? The choice is yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Collect unique seashells at your own pace.

Beachcomber is a calm ocean experience built around discovery, collection, and choice. Wander the shoreline uncovering new seashells and decide how deeply you want to engage — whether that means quietly collecting what you find beautiful, or more actively pursuing new ways to expand your collection.

Beachcomber is designed to be flexible and pressure-free. You can dip in for a few minutes, or settle in and explore its systems more deeply.

Ways You Might Play

  • Active Mode

    Control the rhythm of the waves and actively uncover new shell variations.

  • Natural Mode

    Let the ocean work on its own schedule, returning occasionally to see what has washed ashore.

  • Collection Mode

    Arrange and share your growing collection in a personal showcase.

  • Puzzle / Challenge Modes

    Use the visible qualities of your shells in more structured challenges, discovering unexpected relationships across your collection.

Creative Collecting

What sets Beachcomber apart is that every shell is genuinely unique. With such a wide range of colors and patterns, no two players' collections will ever be the same.

This variety also can allow for more structured, goal-oriented play for players looking for that, as the endless possibilities also create a vast range of potential challenges. Players may emphasize contrast, balance, or rarity — or seek out specific combinations of traits that open up new possibilities.

Design Philosophy

Rather than burying needless complexity inside menus or stat screens, Beachcomber puts everything directly in front of you. Each shell carries a rich set of visible characteristics that you can read at a glance. Puzzles and strategies are built around noticing patterns, relationships, and visual qualities — not memorizing numbers or optimizing spreadsheets.

This allows Beachcomber to stay visually calm and approachable, while still supporting surprising depth for players who enjoy experimental systems and emergent gameplay.

Come to Beachcomber for a quiet walk along the shore — and stay to discover where your collection might take you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pantheon is a visual incremental game where you manage a mysterious machine named Monolith, that can summon and consume eldritch entities. Every entity that the machine consumes, unlocks new upgrades and modules.

Use the siphon to consume

Use the siphon on the Monolith to consume the trapped entity. As the Monolith consumes the entity, it will yield energy, which can be used to buy bots and various upgrades. After the entity is fully consumed, it will be trapped in a module and will be available to serve the Monolith. Every module will be useful in a different way.

Spawn and manage bots

The Monolith stores powercells. These can be used to power various bots that will serve their modules. As you increase the powercell capacity of the Monolith, you can spawn more bots and increase the scale of your operation. You can also freely distribute powercells between modules to prioritize particular ones over others.

Expand your operation

Every entity that the Monolith consumes, makes it more powerful, and unlocks new ways to speed up the consumption. Keep consuming entities, and you will eventually encounter something special.

Uncover the mystery behind the Monolith 

  • Wide array of upgrades to unlock

  • Assign powercells to modules to prioritize the resources you need

  • Almost every entity unlocks new unique mechanics

  • Prestige to speed up progress

store_data.about_the_game:
Steal, Carry, and Cash In!

Welcome to the world of HaCo. You are a slightly rusty, old-generation robot. Your job isn't "delivery"... it's "Recovery (Theft)". Sneak into residential areas and snatch unattended packages or "boxes" from inside buildings. Dodge missiles from surveillance drones, bring the loot back to base, open it up to cash in, and aim to meet your quota!

■ Master the Inertia: "Jet Action"

Controls are simple, but physics (inertia) is always at play. Boost to escape in a flash, or hover to take cover in the sky. Crashing into walls from over-speeding, or spinning out of control... the frustration of "not being able to stop" creates the drama.

■ "Energy" is your Lifeline

The "Energy" you burn for boosting and dashing is also your Health. Take damage with no energy, and you're instantly blown away to respawn (losing all cargo)! "Burn it for speed? Or save it for safety?" Constant resource management is the key to survival.

■ Dangerous Residential Area

  • Drone Surveillance: Get spotted, and it's raining guided missiles.

  • Cargo is Life: Get hit and respawn, and all your hard-earned boxes are lost!

  • Buff Effects: Opening loot boxes doesn't just give cash—it might grant buffs like energy upgrades!?

■ Troublesome "Inventory Management"

Inventory is limited to just 5 slots. However, stolen cargo has size costs ranging from 1 to 5. Do you stack 5 small boxes for steady gains? Or carry one giant cost-5 rare chest for a massive comeback? "Can I carry one more? Or should I head back?" That decision divides life and death.

■ Max 4-Player Co-op

The quota might be tough alone. Cooperate with friends to gather efficiently.

Co-op Focused: There are no PvP modes, but crashing into friends at high speed causes damage. Watch out on narrow ledges... or crash into them on purpose. That chaos is the heart of this game.
